"Con tàu Chiến Thắng" (Space Sweepers) là một bộ phim đầy hấp dẫn, đưa khán giả vào một cuộc phiêu lưu đầy mạo hiểm và những bí mật không ngờ. Với bối cảnh vào năm 2092, khi loài người đã phải đối mặt với vấn đề rác thải ngoài vũ trụ, bốn nhân vật chính không ngừng bám đuổi giấc mơ xa vời và những khám phá đầy thú vị. Được đạo diễn bởi một trong những đạo diễn hàng đầu Hàn Quốc, "Con tàu Chiến Thắng" thu hút sự chú ý của khán giả không chỉ bởi cốt truyện hấp dẫn mà còn bởi dàn diễn viên tài năng. Song Joong Ki thủ vai một trong những nhân vật chính, cùng với sự góp mặt của Kim Tae Ri, Jin Sun Kyu và nhiều diễn viên tài năng khác. Phim thu hút người xem bởi sự kết hợp độc đáo giữa các thể loại hành động, khoa học, hài hước và kinh dị. Khán giả sẽ được trải nghiệm những pha hành động mãn nhãn, những tình tiết khoa học hấp dẫn, nhưng đồng thời cũng không thể không cười với những tình huống hài hước và đầy sáng tạo. "Con tàu Chiến Thắng" không chỉ là một bộ phim giải trí thông thường, mà còn đặt ra những câu hỏi đầy ý nghĩa về tương lai của loài người trên Trái Đất và ngoài vũ trụ. Không chỉ là một câu chuyện về viễn tưởng, bộ phim còn chứa đựng những thông điệp sâu sắc về con người, tình yêu, và sự hy sinh. Với chất lượng hình ảnh và hiệu ứng đặc biệt ấn tượng, "Con tàu Chiến Thắng" hứa hẹn sẽ mang đến cho khán giả những trải nghiệm điện ảnh đầy mới lạ và cuốn hút. Đừng bỏ lỡ cơ hội xem bộ phim này trên Motchilltv để khám phá thế giới đầy màu sắc và sự bất ngờ.

title_en: Dragons: Rescue Riders: Hunt for the Golden Dragon
movie_text: It's the treasure hunt of a lifetime for the Rescue Riders, who must race to find a precious golden dragon egg and protect it from evil pirates.
Snowfall marks the start of Odinyule ? the Viking holiday of giving! But crazy weather might cancel the tradition unless the Rescue Riders can swoop in.

title_en: Dragons: Rescue Riders: Secrets of the Songwing
movie_text: When a musical dragon with a beautiful voice hypnotizes the dragons and people of Huttsgalor, the Rescue Riders have to find a way to break the spell.
A sawmill owner and his teenage daughter become tangled in a deadly feud when a drug dealer stashes stolen cocaine on their remote property.
From early struggles to his climb up the Himalayas, Jean Maggi gets profiled in this documentary that highlights his advancement of adaptive sports.

title_en: Elf Pets: A Fox Cub?s Christmas Tale
movie_text: An elite team of elves ? and their furry fox cub friends ? help bring the Christmas spirit to a boy whose mom may not make it home for the holidays.
Determined to help Santa get ready for his merry rounds of gift-giving, a team of special elves wrangles in more reindeer and much-needed holiday magic.

title_en: Elizabeth and Margaret: Love and Loyalty
movie_text: This documentary takes an intimate look at the complex, widely misunderstood relationship between Queen Elizabeth II and her sister, Princess Margaret.

title_en: Emicida: AmarElo - It?s All For Yesterday
movie_text: Between scenes from his concert in São Paulo's Theatro Municipal, rapper and activist Emicida celebrates the rich legacy of Black Brazilian culture.
While searching for her missing mother, intrepid teen Enola Holmes uses her sleuthing skills to outsmart big brother Sherlock and help a runaway lord.
Eric Andre takes the stage in New Orleans and tackles flawed fast-food icons, the wonders of autofill and the bizarre choice for the "Cops" theme song.

title_en: Europe's Most Dangerous Man: Otto Skorzeny in Spain
movie_text: Declassified documents reveal the post-WWII life of Otto Skorzeny, a close Hitler ally who escaped to Spain and became an adviser to world presidents.

title_en: Eurovision Song Contest: The Story of Fire Saga
movie_text: Two small-town singers chase their pop star dreams at a global music competition, where high stakes, scheming rivals and onstage mishaps test their bond.
An infatuated fan finds an unexpected way to meet her celebrity crush and discovers a dark reality behind the facade of fame and her fantasy world.
Finally comfortable in his skin, seasoned comic David A. Arnold shares his talent for doing nothing, how he's petty and why divorce saves marriages.
A lawyer is caught in a terrifying game of cat and mouse when a drink with an old friend escalates into an obsession that jeopardizes everyone she loves.
Faking her way through any situation, a social media influencer poses as an event planner and is tasked with throwing an extravagant, star-studded bash.
After a single father is severely wounded in Afghanistan, he and his sons embark on a journey of sacrifice and a search for redemption.
In 1917 Portugal, visions of the Virgin Mary come to three children whose message of faith raises doubts in their family and angers authorities.
A teen gamer is forced to level up to full-time babysitter when his favorite video game drops three superpowered infants from space into his backyard.
After blowing a Broadway audition, a self-centered dancer reluctantly returns home and agrees to coach a squad of young misfits for a big competition.
Felix Lobrecht aims his dark humor at overly polite culture, weird laughter, the sheer awkwardness of a walking baby and more in this stand-up special.
A gifted young singer becomes an instant sensation on a popular talent show. But her real goal is earning the love of her father, a member of the jury.
On an emotional journey in Morocco, an entrepreneur pieces together the turbulent life of his estranged mother and meets her adopted daughter.
Oyin and her two close friends are on the hunt for husbands, but find that they must grapple with their own expectations as they look for love.
A pair of officers with history navigates clues from the past, false leads and a ticking clock to nab an elusive serial killer who targets young girls.
Actor, comedian and writer Fortune Feimster takes the stage and riffs on her southern roots, sexual awakenings, showbiz career and more.
When their parents' marriage threatens to crumble, the teenage Salazar siblings plot to reconcile them before their 20th wedding anniversary.
Tipped by a mysterious tramp, a meek fry cook discovers she has superpowers ? and kindred spirits ? and uncovers an unsavory, widespread conspiracy.
A quiet holiday dinner among friends turns into a chaotic night of illicit activity and compromising situations when uninvited guests crash the party.
A stressed-out documentary filmmaker goes on a journey of discovery with a pair of monks, one of whom is known as "the happiest man in the world."
After a foreboding dream about aliens comes true, a fun-loving trio must prevent human intelligence from being stolen from planet Earth.
With a championship on the line, Chayse and her gymnastics team look to a local break-dancer for all the right moves to rise above their competition.
A student must navigate issues of sexuality, identity and family amid Sri Lanka's social turmoil of the 1970s and 1980s.
After the devastating loss of a loved one, Abby forms a bond with his sister's best friend as he struggles to move on.

title_en: George Lopez: We'll Do It For Half
movie_text: Comedian George Lopez tackles the future and the past of Latinx culture in America, touching on immigration, his tough relatives, aging and much more.
The directors of Emmy-nominated "Lust Stories" (Zoya Akhtar, Anurag Kashyap, Dibakar Banerjee and Karan Johar) reunite for this quartet of thrillers.
Five, battle-worn Allied soldiers guarding a chateau previously occupied by Nazis start experiencing unexplained and terrifying supernatural horrors.
Go backstage with beloved rap superstar Gims in the year leading up to his major 2019 Stade de France performance in this up-close documentary.
Eager to marry but constantly rejected by women, a bachelor hopes to win over a former crush by accepting help from an unlikely source: her mother.
After a sex video subjects her friend to mockery and bullying, a transfer student sets out to reveal the truth as campus secrets come to light.
Six ambitious student actors audition for the prestigious August Wilson Monologue Competition, culminating in a riveting final round on Broadway.
A fearless teen leans into the rush of high-speed go-kart racing, backed by good friends ? and a surly ex-driver who becomes his coach.

title_en: Go! Go! Cory Carson: The Chrissy
movie_text: The Carson kids win a talent show with a dance that Cory created. But when "The Chrissy" catches on, his little sister gets all of the attention.
The only downside to a young couple?s new dream home ? and fresh start ? is the nightmare of the raucous houseguest in back who refuses to leave.
An Argentine journalist strives to prove that his countryman, tennis star Guillermo Vilas, was wrongly denied the No. 1 world ranking in the 1970s.
When a college heartthrob is accused of rape by a less popular student, his girlfriend navigates various versions of the story in search of the truth.
Flight Lieutenant Gunjan Saxena makes history in her journey from aspiring aviator to India?s first female combat pilot in the Kargil War.
Hannah Gadsby returns for her second special and digs deep into the complexities of popularity, identity and her most unusual dog park encounter.
After a career of thankless credits, a retired actor returns for a long-awaited leading role but finds he is utterly unprepared for new-age filmmaking.
When a billionaire hires a team of mercenaries for protection, they soon realize world-changing technology and his daughter?s life are also at stake.
This documentary follows gay rights activist Peter Tatchell from his early life to his fight for justice amid controversy and political turmoil.

title_en: Have a Good Trip: Adventures in Psychedelics
movie_text: Explore hallucinogenic highs and lows as celebrities share funny, mind-blowing tales via animations, reenactments and more in this documentary.
In this stand-up special, comedian Hazel Brugger offers her breezy takes on unruly geese, chatty gynecologists, German bank loans and more.
After meeting through a heated exchange on social media, two people with different backgrounds begin an online romance in the midst of a pandemic.
An urgent phone call pulls a Yale Law student back to his Ohio hometown, where he reflects on three generations of family history and his own future.
As a young couple from war-torn South Sudan seeks asylum and a fresh start in England, they?re tormented by a sinister force living in their new home.
Fed up with being single on holidays, two strangers agree to be each other's platonic plus-ones all year long, only to catch real feelings along the way.
A scoundrel's mission to escape his family and remarry on Mars is hilariously scrubbed when a mishap with a black hole turns his son into an old man.

title_en: Hope Frozen: A Quest to Live Twice
movie_text: A Thai scientist and his family decide to cryonically freeze their cherished, dying toddler. This heartfelt documentary follows their journey.
Worlds collide when Henry makes plans to spend Saturday on the sofa watching a "Gross Class Zero" marathon ? and his favorite characters come to life!
A sweet misfit with a fondness for crafts, horses and supernatural crime shows finds her increasingly lucid dreams trickling into her waking life.
In an abandoned hospital in Tainan, visitors seeking to communicate with their relatives' spirits are haunted by disturbing, supernatural occurrences.
Hubie's not the most popular guy in Salem, Mass., but when Halloween turns truly spooky, this good-hearted scaredy-cat sets out to keep his town safe.

title_en: Hunter in the Blue Side of Manchester
movie_text: To honor his father, a diligent college graduate takes on the daunting goal of becoming a reporter for an English Premier League soccer club.
To clear his criminal record, an ex-special forces soldier agrees to lead a team to retrieve a double-crossing mercenary and deliver him to justice.
Glimpse into the life and decades-long career of Turkish performer Metin Akpinar through personal interviews with him and his contemporaries.
Nothing is as it seems when a woman experiencing misgivings about her new boyfriend joins him on a road trip to meet his parents at their remote farm.

title_en: If Anything Happens I Love You
movie_text: Grieving parents journey through an emotional void as they mourn the loss of a child in the aftermath of a tragic school shooting.
An immigration lawyer and a Nigerian woman caught in a ring of corruption team up to uncover the truth behind a suspicious death in a detention center.
An unplanned pregnancy upends the carefree lives of a young woman and her flatmate as they discover the struggles of single motherhood.
A spirited but naive young woman seeks a one-night stand, but after discovering her date?s real identity, things quickly go from casual to complicated.
A teen ballerina discovers hip-hop by chance and is faced with an impossible choice: Does she follow her parents? footsteps... or her newfound passion?
Police officer Pipa works on her first big case while simultaneously investigating her boss, who is suspected of murder. The prequel to "Perdida".
A billionaire's daughter fakes a relationship with a cash-strapped boxer in order to coerce her parents into letting her pursue her culinary dreams.
Jack Whitehall hits the stage with hilarious tales about happy couples, life in hotels, human stupidity and his well-traveled father.
Sick of keeping their love a secret from their constantly bickering mothers, a young couple seeks to uncover the cause of the women?s longstanding war.
Jerry Seinfeld takes the stage in New York and tackles talking vs. texting, bad buffets vs. so-called "great" restaurants and the magic of Pop Tarts.
Between scenes from an excruciating date, Jim Jefferies digs into generational differences, his own bad habits and the shifting boundaries in comedy.
Decades after his trusted apprentice betrayed him, a once-joyful toymaker finds new hope when his kind and curious granddaughter comes into his life.
After the defeat of a celebrated war hero, an ancient order of fighters battles powerful space invaders as the fate of humanity hangs in the balance.
Jo Koy brings the laughs and beats to Manila, spotlighting local culture in a one-of-a-kind show featuring Filipino American comedians, DJs and B-boys.
A reformed LA gang member upends his peaceful new life when he steps in to protect two young immigrants from his violent former leader.

title_en: John Was Trying to Contact Aliens
movie_text: A rural electronics whiz broadcasts radio signals into space and monitors for signs of aliens, but makes a more important connection here on Earth.
Stuck in a time loop where it's forever Christmas, a family man who hates the holiday starts to learn valuable lessons about what's important in life.
A meticulous clerk for a bookstore that has just been shuttered suddenly finds herself taking care of her cousin's witty 11-year-old daughter.
When a restless spirit curses a village that has a history of female infanticide, the town's fate lies in the hands of a 10-year-old girl.
Determined to marry before she turns 30, a woman tries to change her impulsive ways and do whatever it takes to win back the boyfriend who left her.
A carefree racing enthusiast?s womanizing ways end when he meets the girl of his dreams, but their newfound peace is disrupted by a dangerous killer.
Falling into an over-the-phone romance with a rickshaw driver, a young woman visits his city when an encounter with a stranger derails their meeting.
Ayse returns from Germany to her Black Sea hometown and sets out to fulfill her mom's dying wish ? to care for her beloved bee farms.

title_en: Kenny Sebastian: The Most Interesting Person in the Room
movie_text: Fusing his musical and stand-up chops, Kenny Sebastian gets analytical about frumpy footwear, flightless birds and his fear of not being funny enough.
Kevin Hart serves up laughs and brick oven pizza from the comfort of his home, and dishes on male group chats, sex after 40 and life with COVID-19.
When a debt-ridden man reluctantly agrees to drive an American tourist around India, their stark differences lead to bickering? and unexpected bonding.
Science experts and celebrity activists unpack the ways in which the earth's soil may be the key to combating climate change and preserving the planet.
Torn between his past and present girlfriends, a confused bachelor?s indecisiveness spins a web of lies and cheating as he struggles to commit.
A woman from a tough neighborhood outside Mexico City comes home a rock star, inadvertently provoking a confrontation with the ghosts of her past.
Photographer Estevan Oriol and artist Mister Cartoon turned their Chicano roots into gritty art, impacting street culture, hip hop and beyond.

title_en: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
movie_text: With his signature call to "Git-R-Done," Larry muses on swampy weather, late-night shopping at Walmart and other raunchy tales of life in rural America.
When a greedy bear steals a magic stone to keep the forest?s water for himself, a brave hedgehog and a timid squirrel must work together to retrieve it.
While in Azerbaijan, Layla, an Indonesian scholar, falls for Samir, an admirer of her work ? but her arranged marriage stands in the way.
From trying to seduce Prince to battling sleep apnea, Leslie Jones traces her evolution as an adult in a joyfully raw and outrageous stand-up special.
A resilient housewife, her husband and their marriage therapist become mired in a toxic love triangle and a plot to obtain an antique manuscript.
A family grapples with the passing of their estranged father and the remnants of the life he led during his absence.
Little Singham?s biggest enemy, the demon Kaal, is back and badder than ever ? but this time, will he succeed in destroying the world?s best kid cop?
As fears rise over a ghost known for nighttime abductions, Mirchi Nagar residents look to the only person they know can save them: Little Singham!
When Emilio (Oscar Martínez) is diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease, he and his family embark on a quest to reunite him with his childhood crush.

title_en: London Hughes: To Catch a D*ck
movie_text: Bawdy comedian and television presenter London Hughes revisits her past in this acclaimed breakout special filled with unfiltered tales and wild stories.
Facing a murder charge, a genius mechanic with a criminal past must track down a missing car containing the proof of his innocence: a single bullet.
Desperate to find her missing daughter, a mother fights to uncover the truth ? and helps expose a string of unsolved murders. Based on a true story.
The troubling inner workings of a toxic marriage reveal themselves in surprising ways after one of the couple?s feuds spins out of control.
When professional ambitions clash with personal feelings for a modern-day couple, a love story from a bygone decade may offer some wisdom.
Fearing rejection, a young man struggles to declare his feelings for his best friend, who soon falls for another man ? until a fateful incident.
When persistent Leon sweeps her off her feet, ambitious Angel must choose between true love and her dreams of a luxurious life.
Different versions of the same day unfold as Jack juggles difficult guests, unbridled chaos and potential romance at his sister's wedding.
Sparks fly when a crusading but cash-strapped attorney takes on a charming client looking to sue a dating site that guarantees its users will find love.

title_en: Luccas Neto em: Acampamento de Férias 2
movie_text: Luccas and his band of buddies make music and mischief at a new summer camp, where they face off with talented rivals and their tough coach.
From a resurfaced sex tape to a rogue suitcase of money, four wildly different stories overlap at the whims of fate, chance and one eccentric criminal.
Tensions and temperatures rise at a Chicago music studio in 1927 when fiery, fearless blues singer Ma Rainey joins her band for a recording session.

title_en: Ma Rainey's Black Bottom: A Legacy Brought to Screen
movie_text: Viola Davis, Denzel Washington, George C. Wolfe and more share the heart, soul and history that brought August Wilson?s timeless play to the screen.
Rising from disadvantage to become a state leader, a tenacious politician learns that with great power comes great responsibility, ruthlessness and risk.

title_en: Made You Look: A True Story About Fake Art
movie_text: A woman walks into a New York gallery with a cache of unknown masterworks. Thus begins a story of art world greed, willfulness and a high-stakes con.
Journey into the extraordinary world of "The Witcher" ? from casting the roles to Jaskier's catchy song ? in this behind-the-scenes look at the series.
A look at the making of one of the first series to authentically portray and explore issues in a Hasidic community as they pertain to women's lives.
Years after a police encounter separates him from his lover, an angry young man goes on a killing spree, with an equally vengeful cop on his heels.
As summer returns to Malibu, Team Flounder takes to the beach to host ? and unexpectedly compete in ? the International Beachmaster Competition.
After years of fertility issues and her mother-in-law's nagging, a woman hires her assistant as a surrogate. But things don?t go as smoothly as planned.
When his unlucky horoscope doesn?t bode well for his future wife, an earnest bachelor goes to surprising lengths to get the family he?s always wanted.
1930s Hollywood is reevaluated through the eyes of scathing wit and alcoholic screenwriter Herman J. Mankiewicz as he races to finish ?Citizen Kane.?
Marc Maron wades through a swamp of vitamin hustlers, evangelicals and grown male nerd children, culminating in a gleefully filthy end-times fantasy.
New student Acha falls for Iqbal, a high-achieving student who's torn between love and family pressure.
A young girl passionate about AI sets out to make an impact as three friends become crime-fighting superheroes. Based on the hit animated web series.
Determined to make it in showbiz, an aspiring young actor considers turning his back on the beloved Irani café run by his family for generations.
Comedian Maurício Meirelles explores his chaotic mind with scathingly funny views on family, prejudices, turtles and more in this stand-up special.
Charming comic Michael McIntyre talks family, technology, sharks, accents and the time he confused himself for a world leader in this stand-up special.
Scene-stealing queen Michelle Buteau dazzles with real talk on relationships, parenthood, cultural differences and the government workers who adore her.
Longtime friends and local radio hosts Maggie and Jack fake it as a couple for their families and listeners in hopes of getting their show syndicated.
The Mighty Express welcomes a new train and speeds into a snowstorm to deliver Santa?s presents and save Christmas for all the kids in Tracksville.
Years after his teen romance with Milea, a now-adult Dilan tells his version of their love story when a high school reunion brings them back together.
Aimless 20-something Milo impulsively becomes a gay man?s surrogate and wrestles with the emotional complexities of her non-traditional decision.
In this revealing documentary, Taylor Swift embraces her role as a songwriter and performer ? and as a woman harnessing the full power of her voice.
Uprooted to America, an aspiring Indian entrepreneur confronts disapproval, sexism and rivalry as she draws from her culture to start a tea business.
A documentary on why and how "Money Heist" sparked a wave of enthusiasm around the world for a lovable group of thieves and their professor.
A reflective man must come to terms with his forced displacement from Vietnam when he returns to his birthplace to spread his parents' ashes.
Jimo, an outcast who can see monsters, teams up with a monster hunter to fight evil forces and soon discovers her greater calling.
After his life is saved by a rogue Iraqi squadron, a young police officer joins them in their fight against ISIS in a decimated Mosul.
Shuhei?s erratic mother feels threatened when he starts to awaken to a world beyond her distorted control, sending the family hurtling towards tragedy.
When a doctor gets jailed for a string of shocking murders, his loyal wife sets out to commit a copycat crime to prove his innocence.

title_en: Mucho Mucho Amor: The Legend of Walter Mercado
movie_text: Dazzling and tender-hearted, legendary astrologer Walter Mercado vanished at the peak of his fame. This documentary poignantly explains what happened.

title_en: Murder to Mercy: The Cyntoia Brown Story
movie_text: After 16-year-old Cyntoia Brown is sentenced to life in prison, questions about her past, physiology and the law itself call her guilt into question.
When Omar's grandfather forces him to get a job at a tech company in Mexico City, he meets a quirky ensemble of nine-to-fivers ... and some nemeses.
A filmmaker forges an unusual friendship with an octopus living in a South African kelp forest, learning as the animal shares the mysteries of her world.
Concert and behind-the-scenes footage capture life on tour for Uruguayan sensation Natalia Oreiro as she performs for packed crowds throughout Russia.

title_en: Natalie Palamides: Nate - A One Man Show
movie_text: Tough talk takes a soft turn as Nate, played by comedian Natalie Palamides, explores humor, heartbreak, sexuality and consent ? with a live audience.
Trying to fix their relationships, four couples attend a spiritual retreat at a Caribbean resort, where temptation and mishaps add problems to the mix.

Đêm nơi thiên đường là một bộ phim đầy kịch tính và đau lòng. Phim kể về câu chuyện của một tay xã hội đen tên Park Tae-goo (do Uhm Tae-goo thủ vai) sau khi trải qua một bi kịch thảm khốc. Anh buộc phải trốn tới đảo Jeju để tìm sự an toàn và bảo vệ mạng sống của mình trước những kẻ săn lùng anh từng làm việc.

title_en: Night on Earth: Shot in the Dark
movie_text: This look behind the scenes shows how worldwide camera crews climbed, dived and froze to capture the documentary's groundbreaking night footage.
Years after the mysterious murder of her parents, a traumatized woman gains supernatural powers that aid in her quest for revenge against the killers.
A former child singer, traumatized by his experiences, becomes a recluse, nurturing his hurt until a woman comes into his life and really hears him.

title_en: Nobody Sleeps in the Woods Tonight
movie_text: Addicted to technology, a group of teens attends a rehabilitation camp in the forest, but a sinister force there intends to take them offline forever.
This documentary offers an honest look at our fraught, complex relationship to video games from the perspectives of gamers and their concerned parents.
Battling terminal cancer, a woman writes a one of a kind notebook about life, death and love for her son to remember her by. Based on a true story.

title_en: Octonauts & the Caves of Sac Actun
movie_text: The Octonauts embark on an underwater adventure, navigating a set of challenging caves to help a small octopus friend return home to the Caribbean Sea.
In this musical special, the Octonauts must find a way to hold back hungry swarms of coral-eating starfish to save a new friend?s fragile reef home.
Amaia investigates several suspicious infant deaths and horrific rituals. Meanwhile, people around her risk grave danger. Part 3 in the Baztan Trilogy.
In Lagos, a journalist goes undercover as a prostitute to expose human trafficking. What she finds is a world of exploited women and ruthless violence.
Twins are reunited as a good-hearted female gangster and her uptight rich sister take on family, crime, cops and all of the trouble that follows them.
A formidable Kerala chief minister?s party loyalties and personal principles are tested when a damning social media post sparks a heated power struggle.

title_en: One Day We'll Talk About Today
movie_text: Harboring a deep secret, a seemingly happy family confronts the trauma of years past as a clash between generations threatens to separate them.
This short film follows a day in the life of a young woman in Egypt and how her interactions with others expose long-standing stereotypes and biases.
Members of Thai girl group BNK48 share the ups and downs of preparing for the 6th Single Senbatsu General Election.
Two strangers cross paths on a train en route to Izmir, bonding over their turbulent ? and unexpectedly intertwined ? romantic pasts.
A by-the-book political aide falls for a big-hearted Air Force pilot while looking to shut down his tropical base and its airborne Christmas tradition.

title_en: Our Lady of San Juan, Four Centuries of Miracles
movie_text: In this dramatization, the Virgin Mary works a miracle on a girl in 1623 Mexico. Four centuries later, a family make a pilgrimage for their own child.
Tired of swiping through the dating scene with her besties in tow, a charming yet awkward woman with a rare genetic disorder sets her sights on love.
Fueled by memories of her mother, resourceful Fei Fei builds a rocket to the moon on a mission to prove the existence of a legendary moon goddess.
This visually stunning special performance was the highlight of Perfume?s "P.O.P" Festival ? the J-pop trio?s 20th anniversary online celebration.

title_en: Pete Davidson: Alive From New York
movie_text: Comedian and "SNL" star Pete Davidson drops a candid and intimate stand-up special shot live in New York City.
A street-smart dog and a pampered cat join forces to lead a pack of unlikely heroes when their city is seized by its evil mayor ? and his robot army.
In this documentary, leading women scientists discuss the inequalities they've faced as they set out to create a new formula to make STEM open to all.
A heartbreaking home birth leaves a woman grappling with the profound emotional fallout, isolated from her partner and family by a chasm of grief.
French rap duo PNL deliver hypnotic visuals and perform popular tracks from their album "Dans la légende" and more at the Bercy Arena in Paris.
An ex-soldier, a teen and a cop collide in New Orleans as they hunt for the source behind a dangerous new pill that grants users temporary superpowers.
As a visually impaired man attempts to rescue his love interest from a serial killer, the dark story behind the murderer?s disturbing psyche emerges.
Seven priests. Six realms. One destiny. Begin an immersive audiovisual hardstyle trip into the mystical world of Qlimax ? and become one with the sound.
In this sequel to "New Money," Quam, a security guard turned multimillionaire, lives the good life with his fortune until he falls victim to fraud.
The lives of three Chilean teenage misfits converge as they try to find their place in an unequal society through hip-hop and lasting friendships.
When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop?s investigation is complicated by the victim?s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.
In this stylish remake, a disillusioned mastermind assembles a team to pull off a series of spectacular heists ? but his crimes make too many enemies.
A rising Black painter tries to break into a competitive art world while balancing an unexpected romance with an ambitious law student.
A young newlywed moves to her husband's imposing estate, where she must contend with his sinister housekeeper and the haunting shadow of his late wife.
Perfume's Reframe 2019 concert, performed to great effect in the newly reconstructed Line Cube Shibuya, is recreated as a high-tech concert film.
A young screenwriter returns to his hometown to write a script based on his childhood and discovers his neighborhood has been gentrified.

title_en: Rhys Nicholson Live at the Athenaeum
movie_text: Rhys Nicholson flexes his biting humor as he discusses horse tranquilizers, angry letters from viewers, and more in this stand-up special.
Rich kid Teto is determined to prove himself to Paula, his love interest. But when he tells her he grew up poor, the lie spins out of control.
The daughter of a horse trainer, an ambitious girl sets her sights on becoming the first female jockey to win the Melbourne Cup. Based on a true story.
Following her father's death, a young woman struggles to help her mother keep the family ranch afloat while preserving a special bond with her horse.
Ready to do anything to get rich, a young man upends the Berlin property market with his shady pal, till the good times threaten to destroy it all.
Elite athletes and insiders reflect on the Paralympic Games and examine how they impact a global understanding of disability, diversity and excellence.
Director Alfonso Cuarón reflects on the childhood memories, period details and creative choices that shaped his Academy Award-winning film "ROMA."

title_en: Rob Schneider: Asian Momma, Mexican Kids
movie_text: Former "Saturday Night Live" star Rob Schneider returns to the stage and shares his take on life, love and dinosaur dreams in this stand-up special.
Caught in the crosshairs of police corruption and Marseille?s warring gangs, a loyal cop must protect his squad by taking matters into his own hands.

title_en: Rogue Warfare: Death of a Nation
movie_text: As their leader recovers from trauma, a global team of elite soldiers must regroup and stop the deadly plans of an extremist mastermind within 36 hours.
When their leader is captured by an extremist organization, a special forces team stages a perilous rescue mission as time runs out.
Love came naturally for married couple Sonoko and Tetsuo. But his secret profession as a love doll designer clashes with her deeper, darker secret.
In rural India, a child with hydrocephalus gets a chance at life-changing surgery after her photos go viral. This documentary charts her journey.
A star cowboy in a traveling rodeo gets thrown off course when he falls in love with the daughter of a tough-minded town councilman.
An idealistic engineer builds his own island off the coast of Italy and declares it a nation, drawing the attention of the world ? and the government.

title_en: Rudra: Secret of the Black Moon
movie_text: Kid magician Rudra sets out to save Earth from the demon of Black Moon planet, but can he get the job done if his spells don?t work on enemy territory?
Comedian and "Saturday Night Live" writer Sam Jay serves up fresh takes on relationships, travel nightmares, the audacity of white people and more.

title_en: Sam Smith: Love Goes - Live at Abbey Road Studios
movie_text: Grammy-winning artist Sam Smith gives an intimate, soulful performance at the iconic Abbey Road Studios featuring songs from their third album and more.
Two cops must contend with the uncooperative tenants of an apartment complex as they try to solve a murder before the crime scene is wiped clean.
Two brothers ? one a narcotics agent and the other a general ? finally discover the identity of the drug lord who murdered their parents decades ago.
Comedian and Trump lip-synching sensation Sarah Cooper tackles politics, race and other light topics in a sketch special packed with celebrity guests.
After unearthing a tomb that had been untouched for 4,400 years, Egyptian archaeologists attempt to decipher the history of the extraordinary find.
Passions, ideals and bitter realities collide as charismatic UN diplomat Sergio Vieira de Mello becomes trapped in a life-threatening situation in Iraq.
When a slum dweller spins a web of lies in pursuit of the upward mobility he has long craved, his ruse could be especially dangerous for his young son.
While her free-living bestie urges her to embrace singlehood, a commitment-craving social media expert can't stop following the life of a former love.
Meeting after many years, a makeup artist and her grandmother revisit tensions from an old family feud that still hang heavy between them.
A family faces destruction in a long-running conflict between communities that pits relatives against each other amid attacks and reprisals.

title_en: Shaun the Sheep: The Farmer?s Llamas
movie_text: A trio of mischievous llamas from the county fair start making a mess of the farm, so Shaun and the flock must find a way to boot out the troublemakers.
Over the course of a world tour, this unguarded documentary follows Shawn Mendes as he opens up about his stardom, relationships and musical future.
In his hometown of Toronto, Shawn Mendes pours his heart out on stage with a live performance in a stadium packed with adoring fans.
A couple must strive to remain resilient after regional hostilities drive them from their beloved home into a refugee camp.
A young man who gets tongue-tied around women writes a love letter to his crush, but it ends up in the hands of her mother, who thinks it's for her.
A Nigerian musician travels to Brazil to search for his estranged brother, who is living a life very different than the one his family thought.
Torn between reuniting with one family and leaving another behind, Doel must choose between the two women he loves.
A blindsided boyfriend must prove his fidelity when his girlfriend spontaneously dumps him after suspecting him of cheating.
A former violinist grows suspicious of the new people in her life and their alarming behavior as she recovers from an assault that left her blind.
On the frozen rivers and canals of St. Petersburg, a petty thief on skates warms the heart of an aristocrat?s daughter as forces try to keep them apart.
In this silent short set in 1970s Pakistan, 14-year-old Pari longs to be a pilot, unaware that her father plans to marry her off to a much older man.
After living 50 years in the UK, Anthony Bryan is wrongfully detained by the government and threatened with deportation. Based on true events.
From the preparations to the performances, this documentary showcases Vietnamese pop idol Son Tùng M-TP and the passion behind his Sky Tour concerts.
When a mysterious alien virus begins to endanger humanity, an elite team of soldiers launches into space to end the threat for good.
When a business mogul hires an exotic dancer for a weekend of entertainment, it quickly morphs into a messy situation full of misunderstanding.
Fernando is a family man ? equally committed to each of his two families. But one wrong turn brings them crashing together.
Two women in their 70s decide to come out to their families and get married, sparking chaos ? and threatening a granddaughter's engagement.
A young warrior and her familiar search for the sacred place said to fulfill wishes. It's best not to anger the ancient guardians and spirits.
Following four hopeful competitors, this documentary explores Indian Americans' decades-long success at the biggest spelling contest in the U.S.
Spenser, an ex-cop and ex-con, teams up with aspiring fighter Hawk to uncover a sinister conspiracy tied to the deaths of two Boston police officers.

title_en: Spirit Riding Free: Ride Along Adventure
movie_text: Join Lucky and her friends on an interactive mission to save Maricela?s beloved mare from greedy horse thieves who've taken her captive with a wild herd.
Greedy Captain Fishbeard is stealing everybody's Halloween treats for himself, but StarBeam and Boost have some tricks up their sleeves to save the day!

title_en: Story of Kale: When Someone's in Love
movie_text: After leaving a toxic relationship, Dinda embarks on a romance with Kale, whose view on love soon shatters as he wrestles with his own insecurities.
When his son is diagnosed with sickle cell disease, a man and his family struggle to face a new reality as they rediscover their shared love.
Talented sugar artists compete for $10,000 over two rounds of competition ? candy and sugar sculpture ? in this "Sugar Rush" spinoff special.

title_en: Super Monsters: Dia de los Monsters
movie_text: The Super Monsters celebrate Día de los Muertos in Vida?s hometown with her magical family, some new monster friends and a spook-tacular parade!

title_en: Super Monsters: Santa?s Super Monster Helpers
movie_text: When Santa needs serious help prepping all of his presents, the Super Monsters lend a hand ? and some monster magic ? to get every gift out on time!
A new class of pint-sized preschoolers arrives at Pitchfork Pines, and the Super Monsters take their superpowers to the next level ? the Purple Room!
Two paramedics begin to question their realities after coming across several bizarre deaths linked to a new narcotic with mind-bending effects.
Traumatized, violent and yearning for love, 9-year-old Benni bonds with a gruff mentor as child-services workers struggle to find her a home.
Superstar Hideaki Takizawa reimagines his acclaimed kabuki production for the screen, featuring the dynamic talents of idol group Snow Man.
Wealthy and spoiled, a young man finds something to fight for when he falls in love with an environmental activist protesting his family's business.
She's halfway through her 20s ? and she's over it. Too old to party, too young to settle down, comedian Taylor Tomlinson takes aim at her life choices.
A Secret Service agent is drawn into a terrorist plot when his son's classmate, the daughter of a Supreme Court Justice, is targeted for kidnapping.
A tech entrepreneur's Christmas shopping app is a smashing success, but he starts to realize his invention might be ruining the holiday spirit.
Two years after Cole survived a satanic blood cult, he's living another nightmare: high school. And the demons from his past? Still making his life hell.
To rescue his daughter, an unstable Special Forces veteran unleashes his inner beast as he pursues her kidnappers ? and soon becomes a suspect himself.
As urbanization expands throughout society, this documentary discusses the value of finding ways for children to forge real connections with nature.
While visiting her fiancé's mother in southern Italy, a woman must fight the mysterious and malevolent curse intent on claiming her daughter.
On an island, a fisherman's family faces horrors and dark truths when an ominous force begins killing the wildlife and puts their own lives in danger.
A high school senior sets out to make a no-budget horror film with his friend, one-time rival and teacher, but the project soon jeopardizes their future.

title_en: The Boss Baby: Get That Baby!
movie_text: Think you've got what it takes to be the boss? This interactive special puts your skills to the test and matches you up with one of 16 jobs at Baby Corp.
At a birthday party in 1968 New York, a surprise guest and a drunken game leave seven gay friends reckoning with unspoken feelings and buried truths.

title_en: The Boys in the Band: Something Personal
movie_text: Decades after his play first put gay life center stage, Mart Crowley joins the cast and crew of the 2020 film to reflect on the story's enduring legacy.
A group of university students decides to test an urban legend about the ghost of a female student that haunts a campus bridge.
Connected by phone in the same home but 20 years apart, a serial killer puts another woman?s past ? and life ? on the line to change her own fate.
Unhappy over her mom?s new relationship, a now-teenage Kate runs away and lands at the North Pole, where a naughty elf is plotting to cancel Christmas.
Asian American creatives pay passionate tribute to the iconic, stereotype-busting "Baby-Sitters Club" character in this heartfelt documentary short.
When her son is accused of raping and trying to murder his ex-wife, Alicia embarks on a journey that will change her life forever.
In this horror movie, a retired priest haunted by his sins is pulled back into the darkness when a friend begs him to help his possessed daughter.
French and Sue have two days to collect on three debts, using as much force as it takes ? all while evading the wrath of a crime lord out for revenge.
An accident at a remote training camp leaves a group of survivalists bitterly divided ? and caught in a brutal fight for their lives.
Sinister characters converge around a young man devoted to protecting those he loves in a postwar backwoods town teeming with corruption and brutality.
Inspired by Nobel Peace Prize winner Malala Yousafzai, a young girl defies the expectations of her father and village to pursue an education
Desperate for a breakthrough as she nears the big 4-0, struggling New York City playwright Radha finds inspiration by reinventing herself as a rapper.
When smart but cash-strapped teen Ellie Chu agrees to write a love letter for a jock, she doesn't expect to become his friend ? or fall for his crush.
A duplicitous young man finds success in the dark world of social media smear tactics ? but his virtual vitriol soon has violent real-life consequences.
Coping with heartbreak, the shy owner of a floundering cafe finds solace in the Javanese love songs of Didi Kempot.
With college decisions looming, Elle juggles her long-distance romance with Noah, changing relationship with bestie Lee and feelings for a new classmate.
In this movie sequel to the hit series, Chuck returns home and talks to a reporter about life on the island with zany larva pals Red and Yellow.
This nostalgic documentary reveals the real story of Blockbuster's demise, and how one last location in Oregon keeps the spirit of a bygone era alive.

title_en: The Last Days of American Crime
movie_text: A bank robber joins a plot to commit one final, historic heist before the government turns on a mind-altering signal that will end all criminal behavior.
In 1950s Italy, a passionate free spirit dreams of love, justice and a better life till a forbidden affair threatens everything. Based on real events.
A hard-hitting reporter becomes entangled in the story she?s trying to break when she helps her ailing father broker an arms deal in Central America.
A Holocaust survivor running a daycare business forms an unlikely friendship with a bitter street kid when she takes him in after he robs her.
When a lazy young man replaces his father as the elevator operator of a posh residential complex, what he sees as menial work soon takes on new meaning.
Looking to start anew, a widow retreats with her children to her aunt's goat farm, where the ranch's manager helps her navigate country life and loss.
When a couple in the fast lane to splitsville accidentally careens into a murder, they take off on a wild race to find the killer and clear their names.

title_en: The Magic School Bus Rides Again In the Zone
movie_text: Ms. Frizzle's class sees every show on a pop star's New Year's Eve tour, learning about time zones as they attend all her concerts on the same night.

title_en: The Magic School Bus Rides Again Kids In Space
movie_text: The Magic School Bus kids blast into orbit ? and onto the International Space Station ? only to find themselves on the run from a giant tardigrade!

title_en: The Magic School Bus Rides Again The Frizz Connection
movie_text: Lightning splits the Magic School Bus into three pieces, scattering the class across the globe with different versions of Ms. Frizzle aboard each bus!
Using special powers from a magical mask, a young WWE fan causes chaos when he enters a wrestling competition and fights an intimidating rival.
One football match on a dirt pitch near Rome becomes a day of reckoning as a young player, his coach and their team's owner wrestle internal demons.
In the aftermath of a global catastrophe, a lone scientist in the Arctic races to contact a crew of astronauts with a warning not to return to Earth.

title_en: The Netflix Afterparty: The Best Shows of The Worst Year
movie_text: David Spade, Fortune Feimster and London Hughes welcome guests from "Tiger King," "Emily in Paris," "The Queen's Gambit" and more. Plus: Kevin Hart.
After a charming guest checks in, a voyeuristic hotel clerk on the autism spectrum becomes a suspect in a murder that takes place during his shift.
An unemployed advertising executive begins stalking the new tenants of his former home and his motives toward the family turn sinister.
Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.
A reporter visits her birthplace in Veracruz for a story about tribal culture, only to be kidnapped by locals who believe she's demonically possessed.
A group of vastly outnumbered U.S. soldiers at a remote Afghanistan base must fend off a brutal offensive by Taliban fighters in the Battle of Kamdesh.
Unable to face his new reality in a wheelchair, Ángel develops a deadly obsession with the woman who left him and unleashes a sinister revenge plot.
From campy lies to sexy surprises, this collection of vignettes captures the follies of several men as they fumble with fidelity and relationships.
Yusuf and his daughter set out to buy his wife an anniversary gift, a gesture demanding much patience and negotiation skills in the West Bank.
When Margaret's Christmas coronation complicates her love life, her double Stacy steps in to save the day. But will a third look-alike ruin their plan?
A group of down-on-their-luck Broadway stars shake up a small Indiana town as they rally behind a teen who just wants to attend prom with her girlfriend.
After a purification ritual unravels, a conflicted Taoist priest attempts to help a lonely young psychic whose aunt is possessed by a powerful demon.
As he reconciles with his ex and their son, an enforcer for a crime family gets an order that tests his loyalty and endangers everyone he holds dear.
Alluding to "For Whom the Bell Tolls," this drama follows a fugitive guerrilla, deaf after an explosion, as he tries to survive in 1944 northern Spain.
What do you do if your parents are kidnapped by a crew of international thieves? You begin a wild overnight adventure ? complete with spy gear.
This documentary-drama hybrid explores the dangerous human impact of social networking, with tech experts sounding the alarm on their own creations.
This documentary captures the extraordinary twists and turns in the journeys of Rubik's Cube-solving champions Max Park and Feliks Zemdegs.
A military veteran comes home to find her father harassed by a sheriff intent on confiscating the livestock on their ranch under shady pretenses.
Her career in shambles, a reclusive movie star hires her stand-in to go to rehab for her, not expecting how much the look-alike will relish the role.
When a big-city family moves to a remote town, two young brothers and their new friends try to solve the menacing mystery that haunts their home.

title_en: The Three Deaths of Marisela Escobedo
movie_text: This documentary examines a mother's tireless crusade to jail her daughter's murderer after Mexico's justice system failed to do so.
What was supposed to be a peaceful protest turned into a violent clash with the police. What followed was one of the most notorious trials in history.
When their daughter disappears during a family vacation, two terrified parents launch their own investigation that soon exposes local secrets.
Four siblings with horribly selfish parents hatch a plan to get rid of them for good and form a perfectly imperfect family of their own.
Tim thinks he's invited the woman of his dreams on a work retreat to Hawaii, realizing too late he mistakenly texted someone from a nightmare blind date.
A young dysfunctional couple tries to patch up their relationship through sessions with a highly unconventional therapist.
In a rollicking special, Thiago Ventura jokes about life in the hood, social issues and more, explaining how actions speak louder than words.
Abandoned by her family, young single mother Aiye struggles to survive but stays focused on her dream of becoming an elite chef.

title_en: Thomas & Friends: Marvelous Machinery: A New Arrival
movie_text: With a technology fair in Sodor, Thomas and the Steam Team tackle a flurry of tasks ? but can they complete their deliveries before the grand opening?

title_en: Thomas & Friends: Marvelous Machinery: World of Tomorrow
movie_text: Amid special demonstrations in Sodor, Thomas and the gang worry they'll be replaced by new inventions until a mission shows how useful they really are.

title_en: Thomas & Friends: Thomas and the Royal Engine
movie_text: An invitation from the Queen sends Thomas and the crew to London as they weave through delays and debacles while racing to a royal celebration.
A man reflects on the lost love of his youth and his long-ago journey from Taiwan to America as he begins to reconnect with his estranged daughter.
When a ballroom dancer?s shot at a crucial tournament is jeopardized, a street dancer must face his own painful past and step up as her new partner.
Wanting to leave their dystopian world behind for a faraway paradise, three outlaws plot a money heist ? and draw the attention of a vicious killer.

title_en: To All the Boys: P.S. I Still Love You
movie_text: Lara Jean is officially Peter?s girlfriend, so everything should be perfect, right? But feelings grow complicated when an old crush reenters her life.
Comedian Tom Papa takes on body image issues, social media, pets, Staten Island, the "old days" and more in a special from his home state of New Jersey.
Tom Segura scores laughs with uncomfortably candid stories about mothers, fathers, following your dreams ? and other things you'd rather not think about.
This film examines the background and career of Tony Parker, whose determination led him to become arguably the greatest French basketball player.
At an Afghanistan refugee camp, an ex-army doctor seeks to bring children joy through cricket ? and soon realizes that the stakes go beyond the sport.
When massive mutant creatures infiltrate an island nature preserve, scientists recruit a legendary monster hunter to battle the beasts.
When a giant Grippity-Grab snags Grizelda?s friendship bracelet and turns her into a mermaid, True heads under the sea with magic wishes to save the day.
True and Bartleby travel to the other side of the Neverending Rainbow to bring back Dillydally ? a brave explorer who's the Rainbow King's best friend!
Spring has sprung in Rainbow City, and Wuzzle Wegg Day is right around the corner! But Bartleby's convinced that a Wegg-stealing monster is on the loose.
A budding politician has devious plans to rise in the ranks ? until an unexpected new presence begins to interfere with his every crooked move.
Tumi Morake dishes out hot takes and fiery commentary about the concept of identity, politics, family life, weaves, and more in this stand-up special.

title_en: Twin Murders: the Silence of the White City
movie_text: A detective returns to Vitoria-Gasteiz to solve murders mimicking those allegedly committed by a serial killer who's about to be released from prison.
A young reporter's investigation into a string of grisly suicides takes a dangerous detour when she follows the clues to a cursed stretch of road.
An aging soccer fanatic faces down the reality of his past while struggling to give himself and a young follower very different futures.
Defeated and humiliated in a fight while trying to defuse a conflict among his fellow villagers, a photographer vows revenge on his attacker.

title_en: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend
movie_text: It's an interactive Kimmy special! Kimmy's getting married, but first she has to foil the Reverend's evil plot. It's your move: What should she do next?
A young man feels torn between his dream of becoming a master sommelier and his father?s expectations that he?ll take over the family barbecue business.
While vacationing on the beaches of Riccione, a group of teens become friends and help each other manage romantic relationships and summer crushes.
A very chiseled but somber detective must find a serial killer who leaves clues that only his mentor's nerdy comics-loving son can decipher.
When a rude and arrogant princess finds herself relying on a gatekeeper after a terrible accident, it may be enough to make her change her ways.
The son of a fishing community falls for a village head's daughter, but they face violent opposition from the girl?s doggedly old-fashioned father.

title_en: Uppity: The Willy T. Ribbs Story
movie_text: This documentary profiles a defiant driver who challenged racial barriers in American auto racing, becoming the first black man to race in the Indy 500.
Stand-up comedian Urzila Carlson keeps the crowd roaring with her thoughts on recasting "The Biggest Loser," sex tape regrets and boxed wine hangovers.
Three gutsy kids from a rapidly gentrifying Bronx neighborhood stumble upon a sinister plot to suck all the life from their beloved community.
At an apartment complex, the lives of a mother, a daughter seeking an arranged marriage, a military retiree and a young man become intertwined.
During Christmas 1969, the impending sale of Velvet reunites past and present staff in Madrid for fond remembrances, second chances and new beginnings.
Fresh out of prison, an ex-con tries to save his debt-ridden brother and the family pub until local mobsters draw him back to a criminal underworld.
From the Vedas to Vasco da Gama to vacuous Bollywood plotlines, comedian Vir Das celebrates the history of India with his one-of-a-kind perspective.

title_en: Vir Das: Outside In - The Lockdown Special
movie_text: Stage banter takes on a different ? deeper ? meaning as the comedian performs online shows to homebound viewers worldwide from his Mumbai residence.
A bright and promising young girl gets abducted and taken to a terrorist camp, where she unexpectedly crosses paths with her soulmate.
Based on a true and gripping story: Cuban spies infiltrate exile groups in the 1990s to stop terrorism against the island, but at a high personal cost.
Walk down memory lane and experience the soundtrack to beloved film "Generasi 90an: Melankolia" through nostalgic performances.
In this concert film, artists perform music from the soundtrack of "Filosofi Kopi," which tells the story of coffee and the people who cherish it.

title_en: Wave of Cinema: One Day We'll Talk About Today
movie_text: Delve into a musical concert and relive moments from "One Day We'll Talk About Today," a film about family and intergenerational trauma.

title_en: Wave of Cinema: Surat dari Timur
movie_text: Featuring a mix of film footage and special performances, this virtual concert honors the memory and music of revered Indonesian singer Glenn Fredly.
Activists around the world fight injustice and drive social change in this documentary that follows their participation in the music video "Solidarité."
When alien invaders capture Earth?s superheroes, their kids must learn to work together to save their parents ? and the planet.
A night at a 1980s heavy metal concert hits a grisly note when new friends find themselves in the middle of a satanic murder spree.
At a basketball game, an ex-Special Forces officer must face a group of tech-savvy hostiles when a team owner and his daughter are taken hostage.
When two unlikely friends play hooky from school, accidental encounters and otherworldly events turn their day into a whimsical coming-of-age journey.
A detective interrogates a monkey who is suspected of murder.
Back home at her lake house, a teenager begins to suspect that a sinister force lurks beneath the surface of her mother's too-perfect new lover.
A couple facing fertility issues finds their marriage tested on a vacation to a Sardinian resort ? and the family next door only adds to the tension.
To claim a big inheritance, a down-on-his-luck mechanic must win a series of competitions as outlined in his birth father's will.
Four buddies attend a class taught by a love guru who leads them to question their romantic attachments ? until her hidden agenda comes to light.
A young, overworked ad executive with an overbearing boss starts her own side hustle and invents an employer once her business begins to flourish.
A brash but brilliant Indian intelligence agent leads a covert operation to nab the mastermind behind a series of attacks threatening national security.
Sisters Mia and Emma move to their grandmother?s farm far from the city and save a magical unicorn from local cowboys seeking its powers for themselves.
A brilliant but clumsy high school senior vows to get into her late father?s alma mater by transforming herself and a misfit squad into dance champions.
When his frustrated girlfriend decides to leave him, a struggling writer gets down to work on stories of romance he hopes will win her back.

title_en: Ya no estoy aquí: Una conversación entre Guillermo del Toro y Alfonso Cuarón
movie_text: Guillermo del Toro and Alfonso Cuarón discuss fellow Mexican director Fernando Frías de la Parra's award-winning film "I'm No Longer Here."
Discovered by an eccentric ballet master, two gifted but underprivileged Mumbai teens face bigotry and disapproval as they pursue their dancing dreams.
A devoutly religious teen grapples with her own sexual awakening, and attends a Catholic school retreat in the hopes of suppressing her newfound urges.
After becoming separated from her family, a young girl finds herself in the care of a heartbroken woman who faces her own struggles.
An ad creative and a successful exec have a great marriage ? until he wants to be a dad just as her star is rising. Then he brings someone new home.
In 1987, as martial law ends in Taiwan, Jia-han and Birdy fall in love amid family pressure, homophobia and social stigma.
Revisiting life goals set in a letter written as a teen to his future self, comedian Kanan Gill reports back on if he's lived up to his own expectations.
When her estranged mother suddenly dies, a woman must follow the quirky instructions laid out in the will in order to collect an important inheritance.
Through her diary, Anne Frank's story is retold alongside those of five Holocaust survivors in this poignant documentary from Oscar winner Helen Mirren.
After an awful accident, a couple admitted to a grisly hospital are separated and must find each other to escape ? before death finds them.
On India's Independence Day, a zany mishap in a Mumbai chawl disrupts a young love story while compelling the residents to unite in aid of a little boy.
Stranded when the Earth is suddenly destroyed in a mysterious cataclysm, the astronauts aboard a marooned space station slowly lose their minds.
When their prison bus crashes in a forest on a rainy night, a group of criminals finds themselves battling wild animals and a mysterious killer.
Hoping to reunite with a dying friend, two longtime pals re-create their desert road trip from Spain to Mali, bringing along his estranged daughter.
After the election-night murder of her campaign manager at a polling site, a gubernatorial candidate challenges the corrupt incumbent's victory.
To keep the band together, Selly tries to earn money by making an appearance at the birthday party of a mobster's daughter ? until he gets kidnapped.
After faking his death, a tech billionaire recruits a team of international operatives for a bold and bloody mission to take down a brutal dictator.
Four friends shake up their lives when they meet a new woman in their apartment complex who encourages them to embrace their wild sides.
This documentary captures the joy and heartbreak of families separated by the U.S.-Mexico border sharing a short but bittersweet reunion in 2018.

title_en: A Christmas Prince: The Royal Baby
movie_text: Christmas brings the ultimate gift to Aldovia: a royal baby. But first, Queen Amber must save her family and kingdom by unwrapping a monarchy mystery.
Despite her vain stepmother and mean stepsisters, an aspiring singer works as an elf at a Christmas tree lot and finds her own holiday miracle.
M'Dear and her sisters struggle to keep their singing act together before a church Christmas pageant while Grandpa teaches the kids a valuable lesson.
When a neighbor blocks their view of the city with a commercial billboard, a Hong Kong family resorts to drastic, imaginative measures to take it down.
From gifted athlete to professional NBA hooper, Coney Island's Stephon Marbury navigates the pressures, pitfalls and peaks of his basketball journey.
A cop in Singapore investigates the disappearance of a Chinese migrant construction worker who spent sleepless nights playing a mysterious video game.
The residents of an isolated town look to revive their home's identity when a group of foreigners unexpectedly arrive, bringing culture shock with them.

title_en: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
movie_text: Shaun and the flock race to help an adorable alien find her way home after her ship crash-lands near Mossy Bottom Farm and sparks a UFO frenzy.
A family reckons with the aftermath of their younger son's incarceration and a greater misfortune that follows.
Mexico City restaurant star Gabriela Cámara opens sister eatery Cala in San Francisco, with a similar menu and unusually welcoming kitchen culture.
After losing their first child in an accident, a couple moves to a palatial home, where their young daughter comes under the spell of an eerie spirit.

title_en: Adam Devine: Best Time of Our Lives
movie_text: Frenetic comic Adam Devine talks teen awkwardness, celebrity encounters, his "Pitch Perfect" audition and more in a special from his hometown of Omaha.
Wholesome college freshman Tessa Young thinks she knows what she wants out of life, until she crosses paths with complicated bad boy Hardin Scott.
Displaced by Hurricane Maria, three Puerto Rican women navigate their families' uncertain futures as their federal housing aid in New York expires.
A large immigration raid in a small town leaves emotional fallout and hard questions for its churchgoers about what it means to love thy neighbor.
Looking for a fresh start, a park ranger gets a new assignment. When he discovers a network of poachers, survival depends on his lethal instincts.

title_en: Albert Pinto Ko Gussa Kyun Aata Hai?
movie_text: As the police investigate his disappearance, a young man heads to Goa to carry out an act of vengeance fueled by years of pent-up anger toward society.
Mourning their father's death, a dysfunctional trio of siblings must face selling their beloved childhood beach house ? and dealing with each other.

title_en: Alexis Viera: A Story of Surviving
movie_text: After being shot during a robbery in Colombia and losing sensation in his legs, Uruguayan soccer star Alexis Viera finds a new sense of purpose.
Drugs and addiction endanger the love ? and lives ? of two childhood sweethearts struggling to survive the perils of a precarious world.
In a small town, a trans teen with a vibrant personality shakes up her high school's conservative ways while trying to secure her first kiss.
The U.S. Navy Seal team tackles a top-secret mission at a research center where scientists have mysteriously disappeared and another life form awaits.
After starting a family of his very own in America, a gay filmmaker documents his loving, traditional Chinese family's process of acceptance.
A woman sexually assaulted by her new boss's brother-in-law tries to move on as if nothing happened, but the night weighs heavily on her mind and body.
Eight years after their breakup, college sweethearts Christine and Raf reconnect at different points in their lives as feelings from the past resurface.
In this documentary, hopes soar when a Chinese company reopens a shuttered factory in Ohio. But a culture clash threatens to shatter an American dream.

title_en: American Factory: A Conversation with the Obamas
movie_text: Barack and Michelle Obama talk with directors Steven Bognar and Julia Reichert about the documentary and the importance of storytelling.
Time passes and tension mounts in a Florida police station as an estranged interracial couple awaits news of their missing teenage son.
In rural Pennsylvania, a working-class single mom must pick up the pieces and step up to raise her grandson after her daughter suddenly disappears.
From the death of romance in marriage to the injustices of modern-day parenting, Amit Tandon shares wisdom and wisecracks as a battle-scarred family guy.
Amy Schumer spills on her new marriage, personal growth, making a baby and her mom's misguided advice in a special that's both raunchy and sincere.
A teen girl is drawn to her cousin?s hedonistic lifestyle when they spend the summer together in Cannes as she learns about herself and her own values.
Secret Service agent Mike Banning is caught in the crossfire when he?s framed for a deadly attack on the president and forced to run for his life.
In a short musical film directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, Thom Yorke of Radiohead stars in a mind-bending visual piece. Best played loud.

title_en: Anthony Jeselnik: Fire in the Maternity Ward
movie_text: Forging his own comedic boundaries, Anthony Jeselnik revels in getting away with saying things others can't in this stand-up special shot in New York.

title_en: Antoine Griezmann: The Making of a Legend
movie_text: With heart and determination, Antoine Griezmann overcame his small stature to become one of the world?s top soccer players and a World Cup champion.
When he stumbles upon evil Otto Von Walrus's scheme to melt the Arctic, ambitious delivery fox Swifty assembles a ragtag crew to protect the planet.
In his first stand-up special, Arsenio Hall discusses getting older, the changing times and culture, social issues and even bothersome baby toes.
The grim realities of caste discrimination come to light as an entitled but upright city cop ventures into India?s heartland to investigate a murder.
Arranged to marry a rich man, young Ada is crushed when her true love goes missing at sea during a migration attempt ? until a miracle reunites them.
Betrayed by his loan shark brother, a hardened convict escapes from prison while on furlough to exact revenge against the people who made him a killer.
This documentary takes a close look at the lives and passions of the men and boys who hustle or run with a gang on the streets of Lagos.
In a comedy special directed by Spike Jonze, Aziz Ansari shares deep personal insights and hilarious takes on wokeness, family and the social climate.
This short film follows a newly displaced Syrian couple's drive around Beirut, which then morphs into a hallucinatory and nostalgic trip.
When two sisters travel from Canada to Punjab to visit their maternal family, they discover an opportunity to mend a broken bond with their grandmother.
An American science geek ready to spend a summer at sea accidentally ends up at an Australian soccer academy and is forced to kick it with the locals.
Eager to flaunt their success in front of old bullies and teenage crushes, two best friends spend a wild night at their middle school reunion.
In this sequel to the 1991 film, a determined fire investigator recruits an imprisoned arsonist to help untangle a web of fire, murder and corruption.
When a woman is accused of killing her lover, a renowned lawyer is hired ? but the more they try to  untangle the truth, the more convoluted it becomes.
