This eye-opening documentary tracks the stories of five different families whose children are struggling to defend themselves from school bullies.
Gruff and alone, retiree Rene rejects most human contact but begins to soften when he comes to terms with his homosexuality.

title_en: Chhota Bheem and the Curse of Damyaan
movie_text: An evil demon who traded his freedom for immortality lures Chhota Bheem and his friends to the city of Sonapur with tales of hidden treasure.
When two evil entities kidnap a princess in a plot to build a new kingdom, Bheem takes them on with the help of the courageous monkey god Hanuman.
Bheem?s holiday in Nepal takes an unexpected turn when he is called on to save a monkey cub from snow leopards and reunite him with his father.

title_en: Chhota Bheem: The Rise of Kirmada
movie_text: Bheem and young lord Krishna team up to protect the world against the wicked and powerful Kirmada and his equally dangerous bat army.
Two cops form a task force to take down two mobsters, but when a sinister politician enters the picture, dubious loyalties and motives come to light.
Accompanied by a German bounty hunter, a freed slave named Django travels across America to free his wife from a sadistic plantation owner.
The forest-dwelling Lorax has to stop the short-sighted Once-ler from ruining the environment for profit in this adaptation of the Dr. Seuss classic.
Bollywood stars Imran Khan and Kareena Kapoor pair up to play exceptionally dissimilar lovers in this lighthearted romantic comedy.
In this documentary, the director remembers a sister who left behind her life under Brazil?s dictatorship and moved to New York with dreams of acting.
In a madcap stage play from Monty Python icon Eric Idle, comic greats perform the decline and fall of the British Empire ... as told through a piano.
Killed too soon due to a clerical error in heaven, a man is sent back to earth with a new lease on life, this time in the body of his portly friend.

title_en: Felipe Esparza: They're Not Going to Laugh at You
movie_text: "Last Comic Standing" winner Felipe Esparza runs riot in his first comedy special with his wry comments on life as a wild man from East Los Angeles.
A father winds up involved with a stolen Ferrari as he tries to acquire the money to send his son to the leading cricket academy.
Dylan Mohan Gray examines Africa's AIDS crisis and activists' battle with pharmaceutical companies to make life-saving HIV drugs more affordable.
A woman ends up working at the same nightclub as her son?s girlfriend ? who she doesn?t like ? and tries to break up their relationship.
Anticipating the next move in a serial killer's grisly game, a police chief realizes that his daughter and estranged wife are the next likely victims.
This companion to 2016's "Rudy Habibie" traces the relationship between Indonesia?s third president and his wife behind the scenes of their public lives.
One woman experiences the dramatic highs and lows of fame in this voyeuristic glimpse past the glitz and glamour of a Bollywood superstar's life.
Three professional friends, all husbands living with domineering wives, take a well-deserved vacation in the resort city of Goa.
After a brawl lands him in a Boys? Home, a teen seems to be on a promising path until loyalty to his gangster buddy leads to even bigger trouble.
Jeff Dunham returns with a haunted house full of his hysterical entourage, and each character stars in its own horror movie trailer.

title_en: Joan Rivers: Don't Start with Me
movie_text: At 78, Joan Rivers has no interest in slowing down, and no one's immune from her caustic barbs in this stand-up special.
Stand-up comedian John Mulaney tackles such red-hot topics as quicksand, Motown singers and an elderly man he once met in a bathroom.
A remote village situated neither in India or Pakistan becomes its own republic after inmates at the local mental asylum bust loose and take over.
Pregnant and alone in the city of Kolkata, a woman begins a relentless search for her missing husband, only to find that nothing is what it seems.
Cheenu dreams of resurrecting the restaurant he has inherited to its former glory, but his brother, a compulsive gambler, loses the place to a cop.
Chipper baby boomer Kath, diva daughter Kim and hapless pal Sharon visit Papilloma, Italy, where a royal romance and knockoff fashions await.
Urban comic Katt Williams ushers in Kattpacalypse, exploding with more energy than an atomic bomb and riffing on everything from Doomsday to Obama.
When a couple of low-level crooks rob a Mob-protected poker game, a slick enforcer is hired to track down the offenders and take care of business.
An aspiring actor and a struggling DJ team up to pursue the ladies they love and a diamond that rightfully belongs to their oversexed dog.
When disaster strikes mid-flight, a commercial plane's frantic passengers confront their pasts and the possibility of death. Based on true events.
This true-to-life action saga profiles Virginia's bootlegging Bondurant brothers, whose exploits during the Prohibition era made them outlaw heroes.
The musical version of Victor Hugo's epic tale of love and sacrifice, first produced for the stage in 1985, now receives the big-screen treatment.
A vengeful son, a cop on a mission, a wannabe actress and a jilted lover find their lives intermingling in unexpected ways over 24 hours in Mumbai.
Fleeing London to evade a gangland debt collector, Omi Khurana returns to his native village in India, passing himself off as a successful lawyer.
Next stop: New York! But to get back home, Alex and friends must hitch a ride with a traveling European circus and evade an evil animal-control officer.

title_en: Maria Bamford: The Special Special Special
movie_text: Spend an evening with gleeful, oh-so-awkward Maria Bamford via her cozy, shot-at-home comedy special, which has a two-person audience: her parents.
A dutiful son must hide his pursuit of stand-up comedy from his staunch father, who expects him to inherit his store and uphold their Muslim beliefs.
After her husband is sent to prison for eight years, medical student Ruby shelves her studies to focus on her partner's welfare as he serves his time.
Comic Moshe Kasher returns to his home turf of Oakland for this stand-up special that has him sharing uproarious stories about the people he's met.
Neighbors but by no means friends, high schoolers Yolanda and Mari discover a bond and an attraction when they're made study partners.
A martial arts specialist accidentally becomes a superhero when he steps in ? in costume ? to help the cops catch a criminal.
As a man fumbles to keep things in order, his assertive grandmother tries to straighten out his life when she returns to live with him.
Mumbai shopkeeper Kanji Bhai files a lawsuit against God when an earthquake destroys his store and his insurance policy won't cover the damage.
When her son's condition becomes severe, a woman reconnects with the biological father. But the reunion puts a strain on their respective relationships.
When an army of zombies invades a small town, it's up to an odd local boy with a knack for communicating with the dead to save the day.
Learning of a fortune in gold being secretly shipped to Romania, master thieves Charlie and Riya assemble a crack team to steal it.
A washed-up, former soccer star attempts to rebuild his relationship with his son and ex-wife by coaching his son's soccer team.
A farm boy and a greaser pluck at the heartstrings of their town's most beloved daughter while her mom faces old feelings when a pop star comes home.
To save their posh retirement home, former opera stars plan a gala recital ? until the biggest diva among them refuses to sing.
Shy student Tara has a secret identity: She is smooth-talking Radio Rebel, a DJ who lends her voice to all kids, popular and unpopular alike.
As unemployment, drug addiction and corruption plague a society, this drama depicts the people who believe there?s still good in the world.
A con man uncovers a deadly secret and must save his lady love, the little girl who insists she's his daughter and the small-town locals from the mob.
Young CIA operative Matt Weston must get a dangerous criminal out of an agency safe house that's come under attack and get him to a securer location.
With the help of a shady DEA agent, two weed entrepreneurs take on a merciless cartel leader who wants in on their business and kidnaps their lover.

title_en: Sebastian Maniscalco: What's Wrong with People?
movie_text: With his uproarious tirade on modern behavior and decorum, the popular comic tackles the question we've all asked in this hilarious standup special.
A man with bipolar disorder moves home with his parents and makes a connection with a spirited widow, which helps both of them heal in unique ways.
Young and heartbroken, a New Yorker travels to Paris to escape his romantic woes but is soon drawn into another all-consuming attraction.
Two half siblings separated by family conflict cross paths as adults at a fashion agency ? but one of them has a vendetta, unbeknownst to the other.
Set in the jumbled landscape of Mumbai, this mystery drama centers on a police inspector who's trying to cope with the collapse of his marriage.
A taxi driver new to Beirut forms an unlikely bond with a bored American Pilates instructor who loves hearing him tell stories about his past.
Mini isn't eager to wed the rich suitor who's been chosen for her, so she stages her own kidnapping and runs off with a man who works for her father.
In London, a mysterious blind man named Kenny appears to be an assassin who uses echolocation to kill, but there is more to Kenny than meets the eye.
An alien ordered to colonize Earth abandons his mission when he hears music for the first time and is determined to save his adopted planet.
Tracking one family's harrowing experiences, this gripping drama depicts the chaos generated by the massive 2004 tsunami in Southeast Asia.
A heavy-drinking loner finds some semblance of a family when he stumbles onto the ship of Lancaster Dodd, the charismatic leader of a new "religion."
The mistress of a wealthy businessman is torn between her loyalty to him and her love for a young architect connected to her in unexpected ways.

title_en: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn: Part 2
movie_text: In the epic series' final chapter, Bella and Edward's newborn daughter forces the couple into a life-altering confrontation with the Volturi.
Standup comedian Todd Glass gets right down to it, with sly observations on accepting directions, denying compliments and being afraid of the dark.
As the war between vampires and Lycans rages on, Selene awakens from a prolonged, forced cryogenic sleep to face a harrowing new enemy: humans.
This powerful Tamil action film follows the shared fate of two very different siblings: policeman Thiru and his roguish brother, Guru.
A persistent 10-year-old wishes for a new bicycle so she can beat her friend (a boy) in a race. But it's going to take some ingenuity to get one.

title_en: We'll Be Right Back After The Break
movie_text: While fighting a child custody battle against his father-in-law, a taxi driver loses his memory when his son is kidnapped.
When an army recruit is found dead, his fellow soldiers are forced to confront a terrifying secret that's haunting their jungle island training camp.
Spiced liberally with black comedy, this Bollywood drama follows the lethal love life of a woman who marries numerous men ? only to find them flawed.
After meeting under awkward circumstances, a glamorous businesswoman and a tradition-bound policeman begin a relationship that changes their lives.
This animated retelling of the classic Indian tale of Prince Arjun ? part of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata ? begins during the prince's youth.
Constantly denied medical treatment, an HIV positive woman confronts societal stigma with unexpected courage. Inspired by true events.
Led by their skillful staff sergeant, a platoon of gutsy Marines fights to protect all humankind from astonishingly powerful aliens.
A cooly confident aging hit man returns from exile in Paris to his old city, Mumbai, to revisit his past and perform one last job.
Irked by her bodyguard, an heiress invents a secret admirer to throw him off his duties, but the plan may backfire when she falls for him.
Young lord Krishna has fallen for demoness Maayandri?s revenge plot against him! Can Bheem rescue him and thwart Maayandri?s other destructive plans?
The king has been away to meet an old friend, but when he sends for urgent help, Bheem finds himself on an action-packed rescue mission to Egypt!
Summoned by a monk to help reclaim a temple from a dangerous leader, Bheem must master the Shaolin kung fu techniques if he wants a fighting chance!
Eight feisty boys befriend young drifter Fatka. When a mean politician threatens Fatka's way of life, the boys band together in honor of their pal.
A matriarch and her grandson forge a special bond during family picnics every two months, until her health causes a conflict among the relatives.
A lesbian couple escapes from their nursing home and heads to Canada to get married. Along the way, they pick up a young male hitchhiker.
Three flatmates get involved in the shady business belonging to one roomie's fiancé, and discover that a global crime syndicate is gunning for them.
With Asia under his complete control, criminal mastermind Don turns to Europe, battling the mob bosses of each nation along the way.
A financial analyst succumbs to a love triangle with a hard-drinking architect and a promiscuous investment bro, who soon becomes her boss.
A tycoon accuses three strangers of killing his daughter but mysteriously dies before he can expose them, sparking a tangled hunt for the real culprit.
Test pilot Hal Jordan harnesses glowing new powers for good when he wears an otherworldly ring and helps an intergalactic force stop a powerful threat.
A jobless slacker finds himself beyond busy after he runs over the Easter Bunny and has to take over the rabbit's duties so the holiday can continue.
In this installment in the popular horror franchise, a bachelor party in Las Vegas turns into a hellish bloodbath for all involved.
Living inside a Paris train station, an orphan eludes the rigid stationmaster, meets a legendary filmmaker and finds the key to unlocking his destiny.
Politically incorrect and often raunchy humor pepper ventriloquist Dunham's live concert performance featuring characters Walter, Achmed and Peanut.
The seniors in Sakuragaoka High School's music club live out the graduation trip of their dreams when they celebrate by performing in London.
With his fists up and belly full, Po embarks on a perilous journey with the Furious Five to take on a frightful new enemy and save the art of kung fu.
A spirited exchange student and an American man fall in love in LA. But their romance faces an uphill battle when she is forced to return to England.
The father of a high school pariah offers to pay another student's way through college if she makes friends with his outcast daughter.
After a dedicated cop accidentally kills a 12-year-old boy, he's fired, harassed and forced to take menial work as he tries to keep his life together.
When jingle composer Nanda's car breaks down on his way to Chennai, he hitchhikes there with Arjun, who tries to rope Nanda into a shady deal.
A bright-eyed villager comes face-to-face with the gritty realities of modern-day Mumbai when he sets out to find his childhood friend.

title_en: Naruto Shippuden the Movie: Blood Prison
movie_text: Mistakenly accused of an attack on the Fourth Raikage, ninja Naruto is imprisoned in the impenetrable Hozuki Castle and his powers are sealed.
A group of mixed martial arts fighters stars in this action thriller that follows a quartet of brawlers as they prepare for a major underground event.
This thriller tells the true story of model Jessica Lall ? who was shot dead in a restaurant ? and the campaign to bring her killer to justice.
A happily married man gives in to temptation when a wealthy client pursues him, setting off a torrid love triangle.
"Friends with benefits" Emma and Adam are fine with their open relationship ... until those pesky little things called feelings enter the picture.
A seemingly clueless idealist relies on his exasperated sisters for shelter and support after his girlfriend dumps him and his dog is taken away.
The fabled feline heads to the Land of Giants with friends Humpty Dumpty and Kitty Softpaws on a quest to nab its greatest treasure: the Golden Goose.
A couple out to have a sensuous weekend at a house outside of Mumbai finds it rigged with surveillance cameras and occupied by an evil entity.
When he becomes lost in the desert, pet chameleon Rango pretends he's a tough guy and ends up sheriff of a corrupt and violent frontier town.
A struggling fighter-turned-promoter reconnects with his estranged son to convert an old-generation robot into a mighty World Robot Boxing contender.

title_en: Seven Souls in the Skull Castle 2011
movie_text: In this cinematic distillation of the electrifying stage performance, seven spirited souls take on the dark threat growing in shadowy Skull Castle.
When they're blackmailed after a hit-and-run, a troubled rich girl and her wild friends stage a fake kidnapping with a plan to collect the ransom.
When three small-time Mumbai crooks steal a bag on a train, they find that it's filled with weapons and realize that their lives may be in danger.
A police inspector kills himself after a powerful gangster frames him for corruption ? but soon the thug faces the full force of cop Bajirao Singham.

title_en: Spy Kids: All the Time in the World
movie_text: Twins Rebecca and Cecil spring into action with their retired secret agent stepmother to stop a time-manipulating mastermind and his nefarious plans.
In a story of interconnected lives, three families of different religious faiths navigate conflicting beliefs, hardships and other struggles.
When London-based doctor Manu reluctantly returns to India to find a bride, he meets the girl of his dreams ? only to discover she loves another man.
Three cheating husbands end up paying the price for their infidelities when their spouses hire a private detective ? who falls for one of the wives.
Winner of five Oscars, this black-and-white silent film follows the romance between a silent-era legend on a downward spiral and a rising starlet.
Young Americans visit Moscow when the city is turned upside down by an alien invasion and band together with the locals to fight back.
After running away from home in search of movie stardom, a village girl rises to become a prominent sex symbol.
In 1920s Beijing, a host of talented performers gather to show off their skills. The challenge: reproduce a magic trick called the Eight Immortals.
In need of a caregiver, a wealthy aristocrat with quadriplegia hires the last person anyone expects: an ex-con with no experience. Based on a true story.
A street-wise defense lawyer who operates out of the back seat of his Lincoln lands a high-profile case that soon puts him and his family in danger.
A young boy is taken to his mother's birth home in Africa, where a mystical adventure in an ominous forest turns into a journey of self-discovery.
When evil Gargamel tries to capture them, the Smurfs flee their woodland home, pass through a magic portal and find themselves stranded in New York.

title_en: The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn: Part 1
movie_text: After a dream wedding, Bella and Edward enter a new nightmare when a shocking development forces life-or-death decisions.

title_en: Tim Minchin And The Heritage Orchestra Live
movie_text: Flanked by a full orchestra, Tim Minchin takes the Royal Albert Hall by storm with a wonderfully witty evening of satirical musical comedy.

title_en: Tom Papa Live in New York City
movie_text: Comedian Tom Papa riffs on the trials of married life, fatherhood in the 21st century, domestic pets and more in his stand-up show.
Liam Neeson stars as a man who regains consciousness after a car accident, only to discover that another man is impersonating him.
This glossy ensemble drama juxtaposes the lives of famous divorcée Wallis Simpson and Wally Winthrop, a young 1990s housewife.
After he is rejected by the woman he loves and obesity-related issues kill his uncle, a lonely, overweight artist undergoes a major transformation.
Three friends on an adventurous road trip/bachelor party in Spain learn some lessons about themselves and each other that will change them forever.
When his cruel uncle abandons him, a young orphan learns to access the untapped superpowers that have been waiting within him all along.
Sick of his parents? constant squabbling, a young man travels back in time to the onset of their romance, with plans to set them up for marital bliss.
A Nigerian couple living in the U.S. face agonizing fallout when they defy deportation orders with the hopes of giving their unborn child citizenship.
42-year-old Viorel, a distraught engineer, takes drastic measures to end his emotional suffering after enduring a devastating divorce.
After 20 years abroad, a photographer returns to his birth country of Egypt and gets stranded without identification in a now unfamiliar culture.
Childhood friends Abhay and Aaliya experience plenty of obstacles in their paths as they find their way in the world and back to each other.
Having risen from humble beginnings, an ambitious young man sets his sights on winning a major dance competition that could catapult him to fame.

title_en: Chhota Bheem & Krishna: Pataliputra- City of the Dead
movie_text: Krishna needs Bheem?s help: The ruined city of Pataliputra has been cursed! Can the friends do what it takes to bring light back into this town?
Space invaders have kidnapped Dholakpur?s king and princess! The only way Bheem can rescue them? Defeat the aliens in a cricket match.
While on summer leave, a U.S. soldier falls for a college student. But when he's forced to reenlist, their handwritten letters hold the lovers together.
In this intimate drama, circumstances draw together four people from different castes ? which would normally preclude them from forming friendships.
A struggling math teacher holds down a second job to keep his family afloat. But when he receives a wedding invitation, he's determined to attend.
Days before his pregnant wife's due date, Peter lands on the "no-fly" list, forcing him to drive across the country with an irritating slacker.
Bryce and Juli first meet as children, with Juli having a crush on Bryce. As they mature, it appears their bond may blossom into something more.
A US Army officer uncovers a conspiracy about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq, launching a crusade that creates enemies within his own military.
Mourning the loss of their beloved junior high basketball coach, five middle-aged pals reunite at a lake house and rediscover the joys of being a kid.
After an onstage disaster leaves an illusionist paralyzed, he channels his magic into a hit radio show. Years later, he fights for the right to die.
Abducted during the Lebanese Civil War and now in his 50s, Ramez is finally a free man. But he returns to society deeply traumatized by the past.
An intelligent boy born into poverty befriends the son of a once noble family and is inspired by the life of India's president to pursue an education.
This Bollywood spoof recounts the ups and downs of an assistant film director who loathes romance and a designer who adores all things sentimental.
Devastated after her aunt dies, Maye moves out of the home they shared and copes with her grief, yet finds comfort in the kindness of other mourners.
When her sister is accused of multiple murders, a Nigerian woman travels to Los Angeles to uncover the truth and fight for her sibling?s freedom.
A troubled thief who extracts secrets from people's dreams takes one last job: leading a dangerous mission to plant an idea in a target's subconscious.
A family moves into a new home, where their son falls into a coma and eerie events begin to reveal something far more sinister is lurking in the house.
Unlucky in love and bullied at work, an office drone is resigned to his dead-end life until it?s transformed by mysterious calls from ? himself.
To upgrade his life, a simple man fakes his credentials as a lawyer when sudden extraordinary abilities give him the talent to thrive.
By responding to a letter addressed to Shakespeare's tragic heroine Juliet Capulet, an American woman in Verona, Italy, is led in search of romance.
An adventure-loving young woman catches the attention of a handsome beau in this musical celebration of love, friends and fate.
Holly and Eric discover reciprocal hatred during their first date, but must put their feelings aside after becoming guardians of their friends' baby.
When the Hong Kong government enacts a ban on smoking cigarettes indoors, the new law drives hard-core smokers outside, facilitating unlikely connections.
This provocative drama examines how the voyeuristic nature of modern society affects three unusual couples in Northern India.

title_en: Maharaja: The Story of Ranjit Singh
movie_text: The tale of legendary warrior king Ranjit Singh, and his rise to establishing Punjab?s Sikh empire, comes to life in this animated feature.
Years after leaving his bride-to-be at the altar, a man crosses paths with his ex and tries to make up for the past, only to find he's been forgotten.

title_en: Naruto Shippuden: The Movie: The Lost Tower
movie_text: When Naruto is sent to recover a missing nin, the rogue manages to send him 20 years into the past, where he unites with his father to battle evil.
Two former triads are tapped to run in an election for leader of the underworld, but both want normal lives. Each must outwit the other to lose.

title_en: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
movie_text: Mumbai's top mob boss rules the underworld with honor and compassion, but his power-hungry protégé will shake up the world of organized crime.
Paan Singh Tomar goes from celebrated runner to star brigand and rebel when life after sports fails to unfold as planned.
Two indigent farmers consider suicide so that their families can collect a government subsidy that's paid to the relatives of deceased farmers.
When the American-educated scion of a powerful Indian family returns to the subcontinent, his first taste of power starts him down a corrupt path.
Bored with her life and inspired by a friend's wedding, Esra quits her job and dumps her boyfriend, leading to a series of romantic misadventures.
Kirk's a 5. His new girlfriend Molly's a 10. No one knows what she sees in him, including Kirk. Will his raging insecurities ruin this budding romance?
A U.S. marshal's troubling visions compromise his investigation into the disappearance of a patient from a hospital for the criminally insane.
In 1976 Beirut, after a rendezvous with her old flame, soon-to-wed Noha witnesses a violent incident and changes course on a path to self-realization.
An elite crew of bank robbers sets up a daring heist after a former associate persuades them to target an armored car that could be their biggest score.
A newly married couple journeys through self-discovery and healing while dealing with the aftermath of a traumatic event on their wedding night.
Dispatched to a small Italian town to await further orders, assassin Jack embarks on a double life that may be more relaxing than is good for him.
When high school girl-geek Jordan becomes a werewolf after moving to Romania, she must elude her own brother, who sets out to slay her.
Separated by distance and circumstance, two bitter rivals cross paths when the perils of the drug trade unexpectedly unite them.
In a world ravaged by the Fire nation's aggression toward the peaceful Air, Water and Earth nations, a young boy holds the key to restoring peace.
A composer hides his love for his formerly blind ex when she returns to Egypt engaged to his childhood friend ? the doctor who restored her sight.
After a search-and-destroy mission leads to betrayal, an elite black ops squad seeks revenge. But they must remain deep undercover to even the score.
When his wife becomes a murder suspect and is sent to prison, a professor plots a meticulous plan to take back her freedom and reunite his family.
This biopic charts the rise of the rebellious California girls who formed the 1970s rock group the Runaways, paving the way for future girl musicians.
An American tourist seeking solace for his shattered heart instead finds it in danger again after encountering a beautiful Interpol agent.
With a bloodthirsty enemy on a quest for revenge, Bella must reconcile her love for vampire Edward and her growing feelings for werewolf Jacob.
A toll booth operator's mundane life is upended when he's reassigned to a remote spot, where he finds intriguing strangers ? and a new side to himself.
An astute but old-fashioned law clerk steps up to help the owner of a cafe in a legal battle that has both business and personal ramifications.
Upon returning to his industrial hometown, a young man must decide whether to follow his own dreams or acquiesce to his father's plans for his future.
The tripwires of modern love are exposed in a carousel involving relationships and the single life on the most romantic day of the year: February 14.
A man is disheartened when he visits his well-to-do son and grandkids in Australia and sees they have detached from their traditional Indian morals.
This dynamic documentary weaves together stories about students, educators and reformers to shed light on America's failing public school system.
A divorced mother of three children runs a happy household ? until her former husband brings his new career-oriented girlfriend into the picture.
Comedy Central roast veteran Whitney Cummings gets the stage to herself in this debut special, which finds her riffing on a wide range of topics.
On his wedding day, an arrogant, greedy accountant experiences a series of calamities that keep replaying as he lives the same day over and over again.
When a flood of natural disasters begins to destroy the world, a divorced dad desperately tries to save his family by outrunning the cataclysmic chaos.
While attending one of India's premier colleges, three miserable engineering students and best friends struggle to beat the school's draconian system.
This film sheds light on sexual harassment in Egypt, following the lives of three women from different social classes who have been subjected to it.
This stream-of-consciousness drama centers on a day in the life of a gay college professor who's reeling from his longtime lover's recent death.
A cop full of self-doubt loses his gun five days before he's due to leave the force, and becomes an unexpected hero as he tries to retrieve it.
A contract killer skilled at staging lethal accidents fears he may be a victim of his own strategy when an accomplice dies in a mysterious mishap.
A film crew shooting in a remote forested location begins losing members one by one to a mysterious entity that they cannot see or hear.
A young man's obsession with making others happy drives him to help the girl he loves marry someone else, then try to win her heart.
Bound by a family rule that forbids him from marrying until his stubborn sister gets hitched, a bachelor enlists the help of a love guru to woo her.
In this lesbian-themed nod to the film Run Lola Run, a photographer races against the clock to make it to an important meeting on time.
A Harvard symbologist races to uncover clues that will help stop an attack on the Vatican by a secret society looking to retaliate for old persecutions.
In this stage performance filmed for the big screen, an innocent man seeks revenge after breaking free of the prison he was held in for ten years.

An Indian village is abuzz with news that a major movie star is coming to town ? even more so because the town barber went to school with him. But as the day of the actor's visit approaches, the humble barber begins to worry he won't be recognized.
This drama details the passionate three-year romance between Romantic poet John Keats ? who died tragically at age 25 ? and his great love and muse.
A naïve social worker brings a 10-year-old child into her home to rescue the girl from abusive parents ? only to learn that she isn't what she seems.
Bheem and Lord Ganesha join forces to save Dholakpur from fire-spitting dragons, who have also captured Ganesh?s mouse companion!
Centuries after the end of a conqueror's rule, he is mysteriously back from the dead. It?s up to Bheem to save Dholakpur from being taken over!

title_en: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs
movie_text: When inventor Flint Lockwood makes clouds rain food, the citizens of Chewandswallow can feed themselves. But a bowl of disaster is about to overflow.
In the ancient walled city of Delhi, an American-born Indian finds himself on an unexpected inner journey as he learns about himself and his roots.
Because they come from different castes, the son of a tax collector and his true love are not allowed to marry, sending them down divergent paths.
An accountant and a producer hatch a scheme to finance a movie, while making every effort to ensure that it flops so they may pocket the difference.

title_en: Do Paise Ki Dhoop Chaar Aane Ki Baarish
movie_text: When a sex worker hires a gay songwriter to care for her disabled son, the ensuing bonds that form offer a complex portrayal of love and family.
After her husband reveals he's an undercover Mossad agent, an Egyptian woman and their children are taken to Israel, prompting an urgent rescue mission.
When an alien menace and her army of undead minions threaten to enslave the world, Garfield heads a team of comic-strip superheroes to save the day.
Chris Rock hops around the world going from beauty salons to science labs to comb through the mystery of Black hair.
When his master dies, a loyal pooch named Hachiko keeps a vigil for more than a decade at the train station where he once greeted his owner every day.
Against a backdrop of burgeoning social unrest, a neophyte filmmaker makes history in 1913 as the director of India's first feature-length film.
Placed in a foster home that doesn't allow pets, 16-year-old Andi and her younger brother Bruce turn an abandoned hotel into a home for their dog.
A deceitful woman seduces two of her late husband?s crooked friends into helping her hatch a nefarious kidnapping plot for a hefty ransom.
A young man pursues his dreams of wealth by breaking the law, while his twin brother tries to better his life through hard work and honesty.

title_en: Kevin Hart: I'm a Grown Little Man
movie_text: Stand-up comedy star Kevin Hart delivers his unique perspective on work, race, family and friends with this laugh-riot comedy show.
A bitter family battle ensues between a father and his sons when a businessman makes a deal that entices farmers to sell off their properties.
When a young Indian couple moves to the American suburbs, they are shocked to discover that they've become enmeshed in a secret terrorist plot.
While keeping his identity secret, a real estate billionaire tries to woo an outspoken croupier who talks gamblers out of losing their money.
When Vikram gets tapped to play the male lead in a Bollywood film, he can't believe his luck. But it may ruin his relationship with his girlfriend.
A financially troubled Indian man heads to Singapore to find employment, while his pretty wife stays behind in a move that could cause trouble.
An entrepreneur develops an adult entertainment online billing company ? and winds up dealing with mobsters, the FBI, con men and terrorists.
When a carefree man is left with his uncle's fortune, he can only receive the riches on one condition: he must settle down with a good woman.
After declaring that he's going to film himself committing suicide for a school project, Archie videotapes reactions from friends and family.

title_en: Naruto Shippûden the Movie: The Will of Fire
movie_text: When four out of five ninja villages are destroyed, the leader of the one spared tries to find the true culprit and protect his land.
Burdened by troubles and caught between cultures, Riza takes a job as a mall Santa and finds that real life may not be so different from make-believe.
A former assassin must protect himself and a Europol agent from a ruthless band of assassins who wish to exist in secrecy.
Now parents, Omar and Salma hit some obstacles while raising their two children and staying in love after the honeymoon ends.
After landing on a planet reminiscent of 1950s suburbia, a human astronaut tries to avoid capture, recover his spaceship and make it home safely.
After her husband is placed under Israeli detention, a Palestinian newlywed is left to deal with the fallout, resorting to her passion for Dabke to cope.
When three college pals hit the road to compete in a big-time beer pong tournament, their trip morphs into an outrageous odyssey.
On their first voyage aboard the starship Enterprise, cocky rebel James T. Kirk and logic-driven Vulcan Spock try to defeat a vengeful Romulan commander.
A veteran journalist teams up with a young reporter to untangle a web of lies surrounding the suspicious death of a woman tied to a powerful politician.
The stakes are high ? on stage and off ? when a group of talented young musicians face off for an inter-school talent competition.
A footballer for a local club aspires to join the big leagues then gets his shot at going pro, fueling his team's rise to victory.
In the aftermath of her murder, 14-year-old Susie watches from beyond as her loved ones mourn and search for her killer who is hiding in plain sight.
A series of mysterious events makes a teenager suspect that his mother's new boyfriend may be a dangerous serial killer known for preying on families.
Still reeling from the departure of vampire Edward Cullen, a heartbroken Bella Swan finds comfort in her friendship with werewolf Jacob Black.

title_en: Trailer Park Boys: Countdown to Liquor Day
movie_text: After their latest jail stint, boozy pals Julian, Bubbles and Ricky plan to go legit but learn trailer park manager Jim aims to demolish their homes.
Set in the year 1402, this prequel follows Lucian, the first werewolf to take human form, and chronicles the feud between the vampires and the Lycans.
A spoiled trust fund brat finds himself stuck in a rut of meaningless late-night parties ? until he meets a significantly older woman and writer.
On leave in his drought-ridden village to find his daughter a husband, a father becomes mired in the bribery-laced bureaucracy of his local government.
To protect his family from ruin, Yogesh must marry his dream girl in only ten days, so he rushes into dating women with different astrological signs.
A bumbling Paris policeman is doggedly determined to capture the master thief that repeatedly eludes him, even when they're the last two men on Earth.
After landing a job working for her longtime crush, an optimistic woman realizes that the man of her dreams isn't exactly who she envisioned.
In this high-tension thriller, an anonymous caller on a cell phone threatens to harm a man's family if he doesn't carry out every order.
Aiming for fame, a struggling singer finds his long-lost millionaire twin and falls for his brother's secretary as a plot brews to steal the fortune.
A former goalkeeper-turned-talent scout embarks on a mischievous adventure to recruit players for Egyptian football clubs.
Three broke friends pose as an underworld gang for extortion, but their plan takes on a life of its own when their phony company becomes famous.
In this action-packed drama based on an extraordinary true story, four brothers protect more than 1,000 Jewish refugees during World War II.
To win over a landlady who only accepts women as tenants, two men pose as a couple ? but the jig may be up when they both fall for their flatmate.

title_en: EMI: Liya Hai To Chukana Padega
movie_text: A bank hires an enigmatic and unorthodox debt collector to recover money from four borrowers who are unable to pay their loans.
A small-town girl finally realizes her dream of becoming a famous supermodel but soon finds there's a price for her glamorous new life.
After killing a burglar while trying to protect his family, regular guy Wade is convicted of involuntary manslaughter and thrown into prison.
Garfield has long been the champ at a yearly competition for the funniest comic strip. But this time, Garfield must battle tall, handsome Ramone.
Standup comedian and "Daily Show" correspondent Gina Yashere delivers a sharp set of wry observations on the environment, money and more.
A man's relationship with his jealous wife enters choppy waters after he has to spend a night on a yacht with a woman he's rescued from gangsters.
Soft-spoken Jai and spitfire beauty Aditi couldn't be more different ? but their family and friends know that they're a perfect match.

title_en: Jeff Dunham's Very Special Christmas Special
movie_text: Politically incorrect, sometimes raunchy ventriloquist Jeff Dunham is joined by his irreverent cast of characters in this hilarious Christmas special.
In 16th-century India, what begins as a strategic alliance between a Mughal emperor and a Hindu princess becomes a genuine opportunity for true love.
A man finds his lucky charm in the form of a woman whom he had once clashed with on every level, but on whose presence he must now rely to succeed.
When a powerful villain comes after peace in his valley, a lazy panda rises to the challenge to realize his destiny and become a kung fu warrior.
A botched rescue strands Alex the lion and his companions in Africa. Sadly, Alex discovers he has little in common with the locals.
A stranger to civilian life, a young Saudi farmer travels to Dubai, where he experiences a series of hilarious misadventures.

title_en: Mike Birbiglia: What I Should Have Said Was Nothing: Tales from My Secret Public Journal
movie_text: Mike Birbiglia performs in this live concert special that features a riotous selection of the unique insights and observations culled from his diary.

title_en: Mission Istaanbul: Darr Ke Aagey Jeet Hai
movie_text: A television journalist makes a risky career move by accepting a job offer from a controversial Istanbul television station.
Follow the evolution of the British sketch comedy troupe that redefined humor and shaped an entire generation of American comics.
A moving portrayal of the 2006 train bombings in Mumbai, this Indian drama follows the interconnected stories of several strangers.
After undergoing hypnosis, Ramez finally meets the woman of his dreams ? but his vision of her appearance doesn't quite match up with reality.
When strange ninjas ambush the village of Konohagakure, it's up to adolescent ninja Naruto and his long-missing pal, Sasuke, to save the planet.
When a quick-tempered teen moves to a new town and faces the challenges of attending a new high school, he seeks solace in an underground fight club.
Elliot the buck and his forest-dwelling cohorts must rescue their dachshund pal from some spoiled pets bent on returning him to domesticity.
Starting as a petty thief, a man rises to become one of the city's biggest operators and carves out the kind of lifestyle he'd once only dreamed of.
After witnessing a murder, a perpetually stoned process server and his good-natured dealer go on the run from a drug lord who's out to kill them.
Acrobatic aliens arrive on spaceships and perform for everyone, but when angry aliens arrive as well, Pocoyo and his friends must now put on a show.
On prom night, a high school senior still struggling with her nightmare past tries to evade a killer bent on ending the party for her and her friends.
The plot thickens around two horse-racing competitors when three beautiful women come into their lives and a murder is committed.
Four friends hoped that their rock band would be a hit. After breaking up, the band members reunite and take another shot at fulfilling their dream.
When a restaurant owner in Cyprus returns to Beijing to sign divorce papers, a drunk woman he encounters triggers a string of mishaps.
Weighed down by a dark secret, IRS agent Ben Thomas tries to improve the lives of seven strangers in need of a second chance.
Eager to hook up with a woman he met online, 18-year-old Ian embarks on an epic road trip that speeds straight toward trouble in this raunchy comedy.
After losing his father, a genius yet troubled aviation engineer suffering from loneliness tackles a complex project: love.
A thief gets in over his head when he breaks into a bank vault full of cash, gems... and secrets on everyone from the London mob to the royal family.
Feeling guilty after a high-speed chase leaves a girl dead, a determined sergeant pursues the crime boss who triggered the fatal car accident.
When his powerful crime czar boss kills the man he considered a mentor, a young gangster on the rise goes to war in order to get revenge.
When city-raised twins move to a tumbledown country mansion, it's quite an adjustment ? especially after they uncover a magical fantasy world.
A quiet stay at a remote vacation home spirals into terror for a couple when they come under attack by three masked, mysterious, murderous intruders.
Examine how the group of alternative hip-hop artists known as the Good Lifers started a movement and created a robust, progressive musical community.
Comedic pianist Tim Minchin performs a host of his catchy songs that touch on everything from the Middle East to the healing power of canvas bags.
Amid the violence of Pinochet's reign in 1978 Chile, emotionally dead Raúl finds escape in his obsession over the protagonist in "Saturday Night Fever."
When Bella Swan moves in with her father, she starts school and meets Edward, a mysterious classmate who reveals himself to be a 108-year-old vampire.
Everyday guy Kabir is thrown for a loop when he meets Kuhu, a freewheeling party girl. Now, he's a changed man, dancing, running half-naked through the streets and donning ladies' shoes at her whim.
Polygamy, piety and personal principles collide for a charming and congenial young university student struggling in a four-way love triangle.
R.J. travels to Georgia for his parents' 50th anniversary. But after pompously flaunting his Hollywood lifestyle, he must examine what he's become.
An educated man assists the illiterate residents of his village with written correspondence, sometimes manipulating the letters to suit his interests.
Accustomed to getting her way, a wealthy teenage girl from Los Angeles is sent to a strict boarding school in England to clean up her act.
After a bitter divorce, a loan officer falls under the sway of a self-help guru who urges him to say yes to everything that comes his way for a year.

title_en: Zack and Miri Make a Porno
movie_text: Zack and Miri make and star in an adult film to bring in easy money. But their unspoken feelings for each other might threaten the whole enterprise.
Self-made millionaire Ian thinks he's found happiness when he marries caring Joanna, but his love is put to the test when he meets stewardess Karyn.
This deftly animated take on a legendary Old English epic tells the timeless tale of a Scandinavian hero who's known for slaying dragons.
Raised by a father to fraudulently act as one person, three identical brothers end up pining for the same woman as one triplet seeks psychiatric help.
In a last-ditch effort, the jaded coach of the Southall United Football Club assembles a ragtag team and helps lead the team to a comeback season.
While her at-risk students are reading classics such as "The Diary of Anne Frank," a teacher asks them to keep journals about their troubled lives.
After trying to live in the "real world" and concluding it isn't for him, Garfield must return to his comic-strip home before getting trapped forever.
Every time Chuck breaks up with a girlfriend, she ends up engaged to her next boyfriend. Soon, women are dating Chuck in hopes of meeting Mr. Right.
Stories of personal victories coincide with Team India's battle for the Cricket World Cup in this engaging ensemble drama.
This offbeat comedy-drama follows six quirky newlywed couples as they set off on a bus from Mumbai to Goa on their honeymoons.
A young man gives up everything ? including his trust fund and ties to a seemingly stable family ? to lead a solitary life in the wild.
Changing fortunes await a wealthy but dejected industrialist when he meets a spirited chatterbox on a train in this breezy Bollywood romantic comedy.
After electrocution leaves a wealthy man brain-damaged, his money-hungry aunt and uncle try to con him by marrying him off to a fake relative.
An aspiring actor leaves Hollywood and takes to the road to do stand-up after he's cast in a series of increasingly stereotypical "black" roles.
A group of Mumbai up-and-comers search for love and struggle for success in this ensemble drama that centers on an eager young call-center executive.
A government employee and aspiring crime writer, who is under investigation for corruption, is asked by a politician's wife to spy on her husband.
Germany's most celebrated actor is commissioned by Nazi propagandist Joseph Goebbels to prepare the leader of the Third Reich to deliver a speech.

To her Indian parents' dismay, London-born Jasmeet "Jazz" Malhotra longs for everything Western, including her British boyfriend. On a family trip to India, her father arranges Jazz's nuptials to Arjun Ballu Singh, who's smitten with his new bride.
The adventures of adolescent ninja Naruto Uzumaki continue as he's tasked with protecting a priestess from a demon ? but to do so, he must die.
Reincarnated 30 years after being killed in a suspicious on-set fire, a small-time actor is determined to punish the person who ignited the blaze.

Based on a true story, this action film follows an incident that stunned a nation in the early 1990s. In Mumbai, India, the notorious gangster Maya holds off veteran cop Khan and a force of more than 200 policemen in a six-hour bloody gunfight.
To win his true love's heart, wide-eyed Tristan Thorn journeys to a forbidden realm to retrieve a fallen star that has taken human form.
This Oscar-nominated animated comedy goes behind the scenes at the Penguin World Surfing Championship to get a close-up look at the inventors of surfing.
When daydreamer Ishaan is sent to boarding school, an unconventional art teacher tries to help the imaginative student discover his true identity.
Ben Stiller stars as a newlywed who marries a dreamy woman, only to learn on their honeymoon that she's a total nightmare.

title_en: The Old Thieves: The Legend of Artegios
movie_text: While carrying out prison sentences, five notorious thieves in Mexico City share their principles, preferred methods and respect for the craft.
Go behind the scenes at Pixar Animation Studios with this Emmy-nominated documentary tracing the creation and history of the groundbreaking company.
An ambitious prospector strikes it rich and turns a simple village into a boomtown, stoking the ire of a charismatic young preacher.
To retrieve a healing bead stolen from its guardian monks, a pair of bickering twin sisters face off against an entire gang of rival twins.
A mother arrives in war-torn Lebanon looking for her missing son in the South as a cab driver agrees to escort her on her dangerous trip.
In this silly Bollywood farce, the brothers of a Mafia princess set out on a comical mission to marry their sister into a respectable family.
Rejected by every college he applied to, a high school senior invents a fake university that will fool his parents and help his fellow outcasts.
A forger uses a fake identity in trying to retrieve stolen diamonds buried in a penitentiary, unaware a mob assassin is on the trail of his phony alias.
In Los Angeles, recently paroled O2 teams up with a street-smart hustler when a gang hijacks his car and holds his son for ransom.
When a local musician and his band are forced to perform in honor of a right-wing coup, his daughter schemes to make their music subversive instead.
Mistaking a broke, small-time hustler for a millionaire, two bumbling fishermen hatch a scheme to use him to help pay off their debts.
A ruthless crime boss and drug lord is nabbed and held captive by the authorities, who send his naïve look-alike to infiltrate the man's gang.
Dragon and his fellow students at Dragon Tiger Gate martial arts school team up to battle the ferocious villain Shibumi.
A musician's marriage proposal to his girlfriend is denied by her mother, whose affinity for magic begins to meddle in their relationship even more.
When a woman reports that her infant son was kidnapped by a black man, an African American detective and a white activist team up to dig for details.
A struggling music student discovers and tries to complete an unfinished symphony begun by a famous composer, whose career was ended by a past trauma.
Playing straight man to partners half his size, ventriloquist Jeff Dunham ? one of America's funniest comics ? slays audiences across the country.
Unhappy in their respective marriages, an ex-footballer and a teacher find true love in each other, but guilt, jealousy and tragedy cloud their affair.

title_en: Katt Williams: The Pimp Chronicles: Pt. 1
movie_text: In this 2006 show, comic Katt Williams uses his edgy style and personal experiences to paint a sassy, hilarious portrait of life in black America.
Star athlete Rohan has his eye on a beautiful art student. But when his best friend Simran experiences a crisis, he drops everything to help her.
Disillusioned with her humdrum routine, a married lawyer secretly enrolls in a dance school in this remake of the 1996 Japanese film ?Shall We Dance??
Seeking job opportunities, a young man arrives in Cairo and becomes increasingly involved with the family of a wealthy businessman.
A trio of friends sets out to expose the terrors of a vacant neighborhood house, which appears to have a craving for people ? and a life of its own.

When young Mukhsin arrives in a new town, 10-year-old tomboy Orked adopts him as her new best friend, and the two develop a touching friendship that begins to spill over into the inklings of first love.

title_en: Naruto the Movie 3: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom
movie_text: Exuberant ninja Naruto teams up with his pals Sakura and Kakashi to escort Prince Michiru and his son, Hikaru, to the Crescent Moon kingdom.
Young Ofelia meets a mythical faun who claims she is destined to become princess of the Underworld. But first she must carry out three perilous tasks.
Driven by greed, three rich friends seek to double their wealth and find themselves indebted to a ruthless gangster.
A census taker sent to investigate why Rockwell Falls has had the same population, 436, for more than a century, soon wishes he hadn't taken the job.
A tidal wave spells disaster for a ship of New Year's Eve revelers when it capsizes the mammoth vessel, sending passengers into a battle for survival.
A commitment-phobe agrees to marry his girlfriend, setting in motion a series of hilarious mishaps that has him questioning what he got himself into.
An idealistic English filmmaker casts a group of student actors in her docudrama about India's revolution against British rule in the 1920s.
In order to get her trust fund money from her wealthy but miserly father, a woman enlists a naive young man to help fake her own kidnapping.
This moving documentary chronicles the unshakeable romance between a couple who met and fell in love while imprisoned in a Nazi concentration camp.

title_en: Talladega Nights: The Ballad of Ricky Bobby
movie_text: NASCAR superstar Ricky Bobby believes he's the best there is, until the arrival of a French Formula One champion threatens his position as top dog.
Asked by his boss to share a woman's personal information, a mobile phone sales rep falls in love with the target whose data he's stealing.
When an arrogant scion hails his taxi, a cabbie in desperate need of money sees an opportunity that kicks off an intensely contentious 24-hour showdown.

title_en: Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny
movie_text: Dreaming of being a rock god, Midwesterner JB heads to California, where he crosses paths with idler KG ? giving rise to the musical duo Tenacious D.
When the curator of the Louvre is killed, a Harvard professor and a cryptographer must untangle a web of deceit involving works of Leonardo da Vinci.
After Princess Diana's death, Queen Elizabeth II and Tony Blair face public demands that she be memorialized in a manner beyond standard protocol.
In this feature-length adventure, Ricky, Julian and Bubbles ? just out of jail ? plan the lamest scheme yet: to get rich by stealing tons of change.
Set up for an arranged marriage, a young couple enjoys an old-fashioned courtship, until an accident days before their wedding tests their nascent love.
Flirting with modernity, a young woman must keep her new romance a secret from her conservative brother, who plans to keep her in line with tradition.

title_en: Zach Galifianakis: Live at the Purple Onion
movie_text: The unorthodox, piano-playing stand-up star Zach Galifianakis makes a splash on the scene and serves up a healthy dose of his signature wit.
A grieving widow and her daughter move in with her estranged father-in-law in Wyoming, where time allows them to heal and forgive.
Raised under the condescending eye of his activist father, an underachieving loafer is lured into the local kingpin?s web of corruption and kidnapping.
When his girlfriend learns the truth about his murky past, a con artist is forced to examine his choices and get to the root of his real identity.
After 15 years in France, Kamal returns to his native Beirut and reassembles his dance crew, striving to modernize traditional Dabke routines.
Kath and Kel's union is tested by Michael Bublé, daughter Kim tries pole dancing, pal Sharon finds love online, and a stalker lurks amid Yuletide cheer.
Indebted to a gangster, a grifter assembles a band of fellow swindlers to attempt his biggest scam yet, but it's soon clear that no one can be trusted.
After losing their high-paying corporate jobs, an upwardly mobile couple turns to robbing banks to maintain their standard of living.
By day, an 18-year-old delivers tofu for his father, a retired race car driver; but by night, it's the teen's turn to take the wheel.
Trapped in a national park, a tiger expert and a group of hunters turn to an enigmatic local for help when they mysteriously begin to die one by one.
Longtime friends Rahul and Karan head to Mumbai intent on making their dreams come true, but both men are suddenly saddled with bad luck.
An ordinary-looking guy weds the woman of his dreams, but his jealousy threatens to destroy their union in this lighthearted tale of marital mismatch.
Sold to a geisha house as a child, a fisherman?s daughter becomes the most sought-after geisha in Kyoto, but rivalries threaten the destiny she desires.

title_en: Naruto the Movie 2: Legend of the Stone of Gelel
movie_text: While on a mission to return a missing pet, Naruto and two fellow ninjas are ambushed by brutal knights led by the enigmatic Temujin.
Featuring rare concert footage and interviews with legendary musicians, this documentary traces Bob Dylan's life story and extraordinary career.
A gang leader recruits a suicidal Superman impersonator, while a woman driving a hot car linked to the gang plots revenge against them and their hero.
Traditional Indian folklore comes alive in this charming film based on a story by Statwart Vijaydan Detha.
This documentary explores "krumping," a fast-paced urban dance, and follows the man that originated the phenomenon in South Central Los Angeles.
When a novelist seeks inspiration by urging his wife to have an affair, the line between his story and his real life grows disconcertingly blurry.
This documentary chronicles the largely forgotten antiwar activities of American GIs and other members of the military during the Vietnam era.
A charming allegory based on a novella by Ruskin Bond, this visually stunning film from India explores themes of greed, loneliness, longing and loss.

The plot of Romanian director Cristi Puiu's real-time drama is simple, following the travails of an ailing old man who waits for his illness to overtake him as a weary paramedic shuttles him between hospitals.
Silvia Broome is a translator at the United Nations. But her job turns perilous when she overhears a plot to assassinate a government official.
This insightful drama looks at the crumbling marriage between a self-centered novelist ? whose career is waning ? and his up-and-coming writer wife.
An unqualified young man has his work cut out for him when he is hired as a rich girl?s bodyguard to keep her from the boyfriend her dad disapproves of.
A mysterious game sends two brothers flying into space, where they must reach the planet Zathura ? or be trapped in galactic limbo forever.
When Lebanon's Civil War deprives Zozo of his family, he's left with grief and little means as he escapes to Sweden in search of his grandparents.
Teen Sam meets the boy of her dreams at a dance before returning to toil in her stepmother's diner. Can her lost cell phone bring them together?
This docudrama based on the same-titled book tracks the aftermath of a 1993 bombing in Bombay through the eyes of a journalist covering the story.
While taking shelter from a Mumbai monsoon, an investment banker forms an unlikely connection with a naïve prostitute over the course of the night.
An all-around nice guy finds himself in a dangerous situation after he makes the ultimate sacrifice for the woman he loves in this drama.
Carpet dealer and UFO photo forger Arif is abducted by aliens. On the planet Gora, he helps friends escape from a meteorite strike and find freedom.

title_en: InuYasha the Movie 4: Fire on the Mystic Island
movie_text: Ai, a young half-demon who has escaped from Horai Island to try to help her people, returns with potential saviors InuYasha, Sesshomaru and Kikyo.
True love is put to the test when another woman comes between a pair of star-crossed young lovers in this thriller.
After dropping out of the army, a spoiled teenager reenlists and proves his mettle by becoming an officer just as war breaks out.
A suave, steely-eyed London cocaine dealer's retirement plans hit a violent snag when his boss asks him to do one more job.
The story of making "Lagaan," one of the millennium's seminal Indian films, is told from the point of view of production team member Satyajit Bhatkal.

Major Ram Prasad Sharma yearns to see project Mission Milaap come to fruition and usher in an era of peace between two warring countries. But the evil Raghavan will do anything to stop the peace process.
When a cantankerous trainer mentors a persistent amateur boxer determined to go pro, deep-seated emotions become their strongest opponents.

title_en: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow
movie_text: Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura learn they'll be protecting an actress from being hurt while making her next film, but it turns out she's a princess.
After collecting his brother's inheritance, Osoufia returns to his Nigerian village with wealth and a British wife whose presence soon causes trouble.
A pair of petty criminals from different backgrounds get tangled up in a gangster's kidnapping scheme that goes awry.
A free-spirited couple leave the city to retire in the country. But when they're swindled by a relative, life in the countryside loses its luster.
When a storm terrorizes his patch, a pumpkin cast out for his shape must step up to use his smarts to save the day ? and to prove himself.
New undercover cop partners Starsky and Hutch must overcome their differences to solve an important case with help from street informant Huggy Bear.
In this musical satire, an all-marionette police force takes on the challenging role of keeping the peace on a troubled planet.
A wedding singer and his friends try to prove his innocence after he's accused of murder, a situation threatening his own marriage plans.
Haunted and gaunt after a prolonged bout of insomnia, factory worker Trevor Reznik begins to question his sanity amid a series of mysterious events.
Sent undercover to investigate suspicious activity among a group of college students, a police officer gets more invested in his role than expected.
An empress rules over a land where men are subservient to women. But a prophecy reveals that a boy will become king and restore the male regime.
To impress family, a factory owner pretends to be married to one of his employees, and soon, the "couple" finds their lives radically altered.

Priya and Raj are polar opposites. Raj is brash and earthy, while Pirya is sophisticated and something of a perfectionist in all she does. They really are like oil and water, but nonetheless, they dare to fall in love.
This drama follows a wounded Civil War soldier making the long journey home, while his faraway love fights for survival on her deceased father's farm.
When a jewel thief pulls off a risky diamond heist with his crew, a gang kidnaps his young daughter and steals the loot as a rival agent offers his help.
Posted to a small, crime-ridden town, a cop soon learns that cleaning up the system also means confronting the corruption among police and politicians.
In a politically charged India of the 1970s, three friends are transformed by personal ideologies, dangerous ambitions and matters of the heart.
After embarking on an affair with the cop probing the murder of a young woman, an insular schoolteacher suspects her lover was involved in the crime.

title_en: InuYasha the Movie 3: Swords of an Honorable Ruler
movie_text: The Great Dog Demon beaqueathed one of the Three Swords of the Fang to each of his two sons. Now the evil power of the third sword has been awakened.
When the duplicitous Rajiv expresses his love for Payal, a cruel lie kicks off a story of self-discovery and unexpected romance.
Juggling personal predicaments and workplace woes, three buddies and bandmates practice for their ultimate dream: winning a coveted music competition.
An uptight MBA student falls for the charismatic new neighbor who charms her troubled family ? but he has a secret that forces him to push her away.
A student tries to steal a test from a teacher's home, leaving him for dead after an accident. A string of murders may be the professor's revenge.
A nerdy teen tries to make himself cool by association when he convinces a popular cheerleader to pose as his girlfriend.
Still a virgin at 32 years old, a frustrated advertising agent gets the shock of his life when an unlikely chain of events turns him into a porn star.
A young man house-sits for his mean boss, hoping to use it as an opportunity to win the heart of the boss's daughter, on whom he's long had a crush.
Haunted by a monstrous crime, three childhood friends in Boston cross paths again decades later in connection with a murder investigation.
A villager in Nigeria becomes the sole beneficiary of his late brother's estate in England, which, according to custom, includes his brother's fiancée.
Musician Dewey Finn gets a job as a fourth-grade substitute teacher, where he secretly begins teaching his students the finer points of rock 'n' roll.
An ungainly-looking colt becomes a winning thoroughbred in this Depression-era drama based on the true story of champion racehorse Seabiscuit.
A Navy SEAL is sent to a war-torn African jungle to rescue a doctor, only to realize he must also save the refugees in the physician's care.
In an occupied village, a teen girl is set to wed a stranger. But when she crosses over to meet her betrothed, her heart gets entangled at the border.
When a Texas professor and advocate for the elimination of the death penalty is falsely accused of a crime, he ends up on death row himself.
A vampire warrior begins to question her mission in the ancient war between the undead and werewolves when she falls for a human under her protection.
In search of the father she's never met, the daughter of a bohemian American woman heads to Europe and finds that her dad is an uptight politician.

title_en: Amandla! A Revolution in Four Part Harmony
movie_text: This documentary recounts the fascinating and little-known role that music has played in the struggle to eradicate apartheid in South Africa.
The world's most shagadelic spy continues his fight against the diabolical Dr. Evil, who's teamed with a new foe: 1970s villain Goldmember.
A dentist unwittingly becomes caught in the madcap fight between two criminal brothers-in-law trying to kill one another off to claim their inheritance.
An FBI agent makes it his mission to put cunning con man Frank Abagnale Jr. behind bars. But Frank not only eludes capture, he revels in the pursuit.

title_en: InuYasha the Movie 2: The Castle Beyond the Looking Glass
movie_text: With their biggest foe seemingly defeated, InuYasha and his friends return to everyday life. But the peace is soon shattered by an emerging new enemy.
A suave teen sets his sights on a girl who seems beyond his reach. But his game can't be confined to his tiny apartment and family's old-school values.
A renowned music teacher mentors a promising young singer, but when her fame begins to overshadow his own, he lets jealousy and competition take over.
This biopic chronicles the life and times of iconic Indian revolutionary Bhagat Singh, who led an armed resistance against the British in the 1920.
Famed Polish pianist Wladyslaw Szpilman struggles to survive the onslaught of Nazi tyranny during World War II in this drama based on his memoirs.
CIA agent Jack Ryan tries to discover why three missing Russian nuclear scientists are holed up in the Ukraine, communicating with neo-Nazis.
After meeting her potential soul mate, a commitment-averse young woman hits the road with her best friend on a wild, raunchy misadventure to find him.
In the wake of the Civil War, Jesse James leads a feisty group of ranchers in a fight against a railroad baron bent on seizing their land at any cost.
A down-and-out Hollywood actor is utterly unprepared for the eccentricities that await when an Indian producer offers him a role in a Bollywood film.
When Mick "Crocodile" Dundee and his family land in Los Angeles, they soon learn some lessons about American life in this comedy sequel.
Inseparable childhood friends Akash, Sameer and Siddharth are just out of college. Nothing comes between them ? until they each fall in love.
A recovering alcoholic is skeptical of his son's claim that his new stepfather is a killer ? but soon begins to sense the boy is telling the truth.
When the legal system declares him unfit to be a parent, a father with an intellectual disability fights to regain custody of his young daughter.

title_en: InuYasha the Movie: Affections Touching Across Time
movie_text: A powerful demon has been sealed away for 200 years. But when the demon's son is awakened, the fate of the world is in jeopardy.
When gooey green aliens kidnap all the adults in Retroville, it's up to 11-year-old Jimmy Neutron to come up with a plan to rescue them.
Years after his father disowns his adopted brother for marrying a woman of lower social standing, a young man goes on a mission to reunite his family.

title_en: Kevin James: Sweat the Small Stuff
movie_text: The film and television star riffs on life's many royal pains in this hourlong special taped at New York City's Hudson Theatre in 2001.

title_en: Kyo Kii... Main Jhuth Nahin Bolta
movie_text: The life and career of a lawyer are thrown into chaos when his son's wish magically renders him incapable of telling a lie.
In 1890s India, an arrogant British commander challenges the harshly taxed residents of Champaner to a high-stakes cricket match.
When dazzling L.A. sorority girl Elle Woods gets dumped by her snobby boyfriend, she decides to win him back by following him to Harvard Law School.
On a bet, a gridiron hero at John Hughes High School sets out to turn a bespectacled artist into a prom queen in this outrageous parody.
Peter and Bobby Farrelly outdo themselves with this partially animated tale about an out-of-shape 40-year-old man who's the host to various organisms.
A gifted hacker with a criminal past is recruited by a group of shadowy, seductive figures for an elaborate scheme where nothing is quite as it seems.
A rookie cop with one day to prove himself to a veteran LAPD narcotics officer receives a crash course in his mentor's questionable brand of justice.
In 1974, a rural town in Anatolia gets its first television set ? an event that's met with both excitement and trepidation by the villagers.
In the year 3000, an alien race known as the Psychlos devastate planet Earth and force the surviving human population into slavery.
A tight-knit trio of specially trained agents wield weapons ? and charm ? as they track down stolen software in this reboot of the classic TV series.
Fiza's brother disappears during Mumbai's horrifying 1993 riots. Each day, Fiza and her widowed mother hope that he will return.

title_en: Monty Python: Before the Flying Circus
movie_text: Discover how six seemingly ordinary but supremely talented men became Monty Python, sketch comedy's revolutionary comedy troupe.
In this Bollywood entertainment, two journalists, Ajay and Ria, work for rival TV stations and compete heavily to mask their feelings for each other.
The Rugrats take to the big screen and visit Paris when Mr. Pickles gets summoned to fix a giant robot at the EuroReptarland theme park.

When a snow day shuts down the whole town, the Wheeler family cuts loose. Hal makes a play for the most popular girl in his school, 10-year-old Natalie takes on the dreaded snowplow man, and Dad gets into a showdown with a rival meteorologist.
A retired engineer agrees to help NASA prevent a Russian satellite from falling to Earth if he and his over-the-hill pals can man the mission.

title_en: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
movie_text: After getting engaged, Sherman Klump prepares for his big day. But his sinister alter ego Buddy Love threatens to ruin his wedding and reputation.
Comedians Steve Harvey, Cedric the Entertainer, D.L. Hughley and Bernie Mac hit the stage in an iconic stand-up concert directed by Spike Lee.
An unhappily married dentist becomes mixed up with mobsters and murder plots when he discovers that a notorious hit man has moved in next door.

title_en: Austin Powers: The Spy Who Shagged Me
movie_text: When diabolical genius Dr. Evil travels back in time to steal superspy Austin Powers's "mojo," Austin must return to the swingin' '60s himself.
Scientists conduct research on sharks in search of an Alzheimer's cure. But a dangerous shortcut leads to huge sharks with near-human intelligence.
After being framed and serving time for her husband's supposed murder, Libby decides to kill her "late" husband for good.

title_en: Have You Ever Seen Fireflies? - Theatre Play
movie_text: Yilmaz Erdogan's lauded stage play traces the life of wunderkind Gülseren as she navigates social and political change.
After receiving a heart transplant from a murdered man, a cop is followed around by the victim?s ghost, who won?t rest until his death has been avenged.
Rookie cop Jeffrey Cole poses as a drug dealer to take down a crime lord and soon gets caught up in an underworld of bribery, intimidation and murder.
Following the brutal 1949 murder of a small Mexican town's mayor, genteel and humble janitor Juan Vargas is appointed his successor.
Through chance, history and divine intervention, a cast of eclectic characters weaves and warps through each other's lives on a random day in California.
A smooth talker falls for a music teacher aboard a cruise, but a cruel twist of fate hinders their plans to meet again months later.
A team of far-from-super heroes try to earn respect by springing into action when brave and dashing Captain Amazing disappears.
In this adaptation of a Thai folk tale, a man returns from war to his family, unaware of a sad secret about what happened to them while he was away.
When his parents adopt a mouse instead of a little boy, George realizes brothers come in all shapes and sizes. But Snowbell the cat is not so welcoming.
When a graduate student elopes with a plucky reporter, his wealthy, possessive mother connives with his militant brother-in-law to wreck the union.
A scheming matriarch plots to cut off her disabled stepson and his wife from the family fortune, creating a division within the clan.
An ex-Universal Soldier working to design smarter cyborg warriors discovers that the supercomputer controlling the soldiers has a sinister agenda.
Three intrepid teens roam the streets of Beirut in the midst of civil war, filming on a Super 8 camera and reckoning with the pains of growing up.
A would-be writer lands a job as a croupier to make ends meet. But when he becomes involved with a gambler, he is lured into taking part in a heist.
Hilarious mix-ups and deadly encounters ensue when a convict seeks to escape authorities by assuming the identity of his doppelgänger, a perky chef.
A 17-year-old confronts confusion and heartbreak as he rediscovers his sexuality in this story about coming out and its social consequences.
Fifteen years after the Second Impact, apathetic teen Shinji joins his father's group NERV to fight the Angels. But the truth may destroy them all.
After getting their hands on a misdirected shipment of cell phones, two hustlers try to cash in by hawking the merchandise from the back of their van.
When the father of the man she loves insists that his twin sons marry twin sisters, a woman creates an alter ego that might be a bit too convincing.
Per her mother?s last wish, a girl sets out to reunite her father with the college best friend who loved him ? only to discover the woman is engaged.
The members of Monty Python reunite on stage to talk about making their iconic show that changed sketch comedy forever.
In this low-budget short film, two best buddies meet up for a night of booze-fueled fun before one of them moves to Vancouver.
On the run from Indian police, a mysterious man escapes to Australia and falls in love with the daughter of an Indian criminal who lives there.
This Oscar-winning documentary recounts the harrowing stories of five Hungarian Jews who endured the horrors of the Holocaust and Hitler's reign.
When his baby brother Dil is born, Tommy Pickles and his pals decide that he's too much responsibility and try to return him to the hospital.
A physician finds himself in heaven after an accident, inhabiting the landscape of his wife's paintings while seeking to rescue her from the underworld.

title_en: Why Do Fools Fall in Love
movie_text: In this rock 'n' roll comedy-drama, three women go to court over royalties from the one-hit-wonder singer they all loved ? and whom they all married.
When terrorists hijack Air Force One with the president and his family on board, the commander-in-chief takes matters into his own well-trained hands.

title_en: Austin Powers: International Man of Mystery
movie_text: A swingin' fashion photographer by day and a groovy British secret agent by night, superspy Austin Powers must foil the sinister schemes of Dr. Evil.
Raised by ninjas, a big-hearted but bumbling orphan travels to Beverly Hills on a mission to help a woman investigate her shady boyfriend.
Two young newlyweds seek out the help of unlicensed sex therapist Baltazar, who initiates the couple into the mysteries of tantric sex.
